# SIV

## Extraction

### combined counts

Prerequisites: `extractionScripts/submissionScripts/Figure4/stepThree_process_SIV.sh` and `extractionScripts/submissionScripts/Figure4/stepThree_process_SIV_TenX.sh`
run after their stepTwo jobs, the Seurat UMAP coordinates, the barcode singlet
table at threshold 4, and `GFP_invitro_CD4T_counts.csv` from
`extractionScripts/submissionScripts/Figure4/stepFive_markers.sh`.

```{r}
care.dir      <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/CaRe/bamsort/reads/")
tenx.dir        <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/singleCell/bamsort/reads/")
barcode.dir    <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/barcode/")
umap.dir       <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/singleCell/Seurat/UMAPcoords/")
expression.dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/singleCell/Seurat/expressionDF/")
output.dir     <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/combined/dataframes/")
dir.create(output.dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

sample_name <- "GFP_invitro"
tenx_sample  <- "GEX_GFP_invitro"

# minimums
process_all_set_minimums(mode = "CaRe", sample_list = sample_name,
                           input_dir = care.dir, save_output = TRUE,
                           output_dir = paste0(care.dir, "minimum/"),
                           min_reads = 2, min_umi = 2)
process_all_set_minimums(mode = "GEX", sample_list = tenx_sample,
                           input_dir = tenx.dir, save_output = TRUE,
                           output_dir = paste0(tenx.dir, "minimum/"),
                           min_reads = 1, min_umi = 1)

# Loading
care_data   <- read.csv(paste0(care.dir, sample_name, "_UMI_read_counts_full.csv"))
tenx_data     <- read.csv(paste0(tenx.dir, tenx_sample, "_UMI_read_counts_full.csv"))
care_umi    <- read.csv(paste0(care.dir, "minimum/valid_UMI/", sample_name,
                                "_CaRe_valid_cellID_UMI.csv"))
tenx_umi      <- read.csv(paste0(tenx.dir, "minimum/valid_UMI/", tenx_sample,
                                "_GEX_valid_cellID_UMI.csv"))
umap_data    <- read.csv(paste0(umap.dir, sample_name, "UMAP_coords.csv"),
                         row.names = "X")
barcode_data <- read.csv(paste0(barcode.dir, "filtered_barcoded_cells_threshold4.csv"),
                         row.names = "X")
legacy_cd4   <- read.csv(paste0(expression.dir, sample_name, "_CD4T.csv"),
                         row.names = "X")

tenx_processed <- tenx_data %>%
  mutate(cellID = as.character(cellID)) %>%
  semi_join(tenx_umi, by = c("cellID", "UMI"))
care_processed <- care_data %>%
  mutate(cellID = as.character(cellID)) %>%
  semi_join(care_umi, by = c("cellID", "UMI"))

full_processed <- full_join(tenx_processed, care_processed,
                            by = c("cellID", "UMI"),
                            relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  resolve_multimap_gs() %>%
  count(cellID, category) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = category, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(total = log1p(rowSums(select(., -cellID), na.rm = TRUE)))

result <- data.frame(cellID = unique(as.character(umap_data$cellID))) %>%
  left_join(umap_data %>% select(-any_of("V2"), -sample), by = "cellID") %>%
  left_join(barcode_data, by = "cellID") %>%
  left_join(full_processed, by = "cellID")
result$barcode[is.na(result$barcode)] <- "none"
result[is.na(result)] <- 0

# Cell type filtering
legacy_keep <- legacy_cd4 %>%
  transmute(cellID        = as.character(cellID),
            CD4_signature = as.integer(IL7R > 0 | LCK > 0 | LEF1 > 0 | TCF7 > 0),
            CD8           = as.integer(CD8A > 0 | CD8B > 0)) %>%
  filter(CD4_signature == 0 | CD8 == 0) %>%
  pull(cellID)
result <- result %>% filter(cellID %in% legacy_keep)
combined_data <- result %>%
  left_join(cd4t_gate_table(sample_name, expression.dir = expression.dir),
            by = "cellID")

# Saving
write.csv(combined_data, paste0(output.dir, sample_name, "_all_gated.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

cat(sprintf("%s: %d cells | %d CD4 T | %d excluded by a lineage marker\n",
            sample_name, nrow(combined_data),
            sum(combined_data$cd4t %in% TRUE),
            sum(combined_data$excluded %in% TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("SIV+ (total > 0): %d ungated | %d inside the CD4 T gate\n",
            sum(combined_data$total > 0),
            sum(combined_data$total > 0 & combined_data$cd4t %in% TRUE)))
```

# Barcode
## Extraction

### Panel C abundance

Prerequisites: the barcode `stepThree` and `stepFour` tables under
`Figure4/barcode/`.

```{r}
base.dir    <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/barcode/stepThree/")
singlet.dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/barcode/stepFour/")
umap.dir    <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/singleCell/Seurat/UMAPcoords/")
output.dir  <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/barcode/")
dir.create(output.dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

side_reactions <- c("GFP_barcode_1", "GFP_barcode_9")

UMAP_data <- read.csv(paste0(umap.dir, "GFP_invitro_GFP.csv"),
                      row.names = "X") %>%
  select(cellID, UMAP1, UMAP2, cluster, size)

singlet_1 <- read.csv(paste0(singlet.dir, "GFP_barcode_1__singlets_all.txt"),
                      col.names = "cellID")
singlet_9 <- read.csv(paste0(singlet.dir, "GFP_barcode_9__singlets_all.txt"),
                      col.names = "cellID")
singlet_data <- data.frame(cellID = union(singlet_1$cellID, singlet_9$cellID)) %>%
  mutate(cellID = paste0(cellID, "-1"))

abundance_per_threshold <- bind_rows(lapply(0:5, function(thr) {
  barcodeData <- list()
  for (i in side_reactions) {
    temp <- read.delim(file.path(base.dir, i, "stepThreeStarcodeShavedReads.txt"))
    barcodeData[[i]] <- temp %>% mutate(cellID = paste0(cellID, "-1")) %>%
      select(cellID, UMI, BC50StarcodeD8) %>%
      filter(cellID %in% singlet_data$cellID) %>%
      filter(cellID %in% UMAP_data$cellID) %>%
      count(cellID, BC50StarcodeD8, name = "count") %>%
      filter(count > thr)
  }
  lib1 <- barcodeData[[1]] %>% count(BC50StarcodeD8, name = "lib1_abundance")
  lib2 <- barcodeData[[2]] %>% count(BC50StarcodeD8, name = "lib2_abundance")
  inner_join(lib1, lib2, by = "BC50StarcodeD8") %>%
    mutate(threshold = thr)
}))

write.csv(abundance_per_threshold,
          paste0(output.dir, "figure4_panelC_abundance.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

### Panel E distances + clone coherence setup

Prerequisites: the `GFP_invitro` Seurat RDS under
`Figure4/singleCell/Seurat/RDS/`, and the barcode `stepFour` singlet table.

```{r}
rds.dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/singleCell/Seurat/RDS/")
seurat_obj <- readRDS(paste0(rds.dir, "GFP_invitro.rds"))

combined.dir  <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/combined/")
combined_data <- read.csv(paste0(combined.dir, "dataframes/GFP_invitro_all_gated.csv"))

barcode_map <- combined_data %>% select(cellID, barcode) %>% distinct()
seurat_obj@meta.data$cellID <- rownames(seurat_obj@meta.data)
seurat_obj@meta.data <- seurat_obj@meta.data %>%
  left_join(barcode_map, by = "cellID")
rownames(seurat_obj@meta.data) <- seurat_obj@meta.data$cellID

barcode_counts <- seurat_obj@meta.data %>%
  filter(barcode != "none") %>%
  count(barcode, name = "clone_size")
seurat_obj@meta.data <- seurat_obj@meta.data %>%
  left_join(barcode_counts, by = "barcode") %>%
  mutate(
    clone_size     = ifelse(barcode == "none", NA_integer_, clone_size),
    is_singleton   = clone_size == 1,
    barcode_status = case_when(
      barcode == "none" ~ "unbarcoded",
      clone_size == 1   ~ "singleton",
      clone_size > 1    ~ "clone"
    )
  )
rownames(seurat_obj@meta.data) <- seurat_obj@meta.data$cellID
```

### Panel E distances

Prerequisites: the `### Panel E distances + clone coherence setup` chunk above.

```{r}
pair_dist <- function(pairs, pca) {
  sqrt(rowSums((pca[pairs[,1],] - pca[pairs[,2],])^2))
}

compute_distance_df <- function(seurat_obj, restrict_cluster = NULL,
                                n_pairs = 2000, seed = 42) {
  set.seed(seed)

  if (is.null(restrict_cluster)) {
    sub <- subset(seurat_obj, barcode_status %in% c("singleton", "clone"))
  } else {
    sub <- subset(seurat_obj, seurat_clusters == restrict_cluster &
                              barcode_status %in% c("singleton", "clone"))
  }

  pca <- Embeddings(sub, "pca")[, 1:REDUCTION_DIMENSIONS]
  meta_sub <- sub@meta.data
  is_sing  <- meta_sub$is_singleton

  sing_idx  <- which(is_sing)
  clone_idx <- which(!is_sing)

  clone_barcodes <- meta_sub$barcode[clone_idx]
  bc_counts <- table(clone_barcodes)
  eligible_bcs <- names(bc_counts[bc_counts >= 2])

  within_pairs <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_pairs, ncol = 2)
  for (k in seq_len(n_pairs)) {
    bc <- sample(eligible_bcs, 1)
    members <- clone_idx[clone_barcodes == bc]
    picked <- sample(members, 2, replace = FALSE)
    within_pairs[k,] <- picked
  }
  d_within <- pair_dist(within_pairs, pca)

  between_pairs <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_pairs, ncol = 2)
  for (k in seq_len(n_pairs)) {
    i <- sample(clone_idx, 1)
    j <- sample(clone_idx, 1)
    while (meta_sub$barcode[j] == meta_sub$barcode[i]) {
      j <- sample(clone_idx, 1)
    }
    between_pairs[k,] <- c(i, j)
  }
  d_between <- pair_dist(between_pairs, pca)

  ss_pairs <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_pairs, ncol = 2)
  for (k in seq_len(n_pairs)) {
    picked <- sample(sing_idx, 2, replace = TRUE)
    while (picked[1] == picked[2]) {
      picked <- sample(sing_idx, 2, replace = TRUE)
    }
    ss_pairs[k,] <- picked
  }
  d_ss <- pair_dist(ss_pairs, pca)

  cs_pairs <- cbind(
    sample(clone_idx, n_pairs, replace = TRUE),
    sample(sing_idx,  n_pairs, replace = TRUE)
  )
  d_cs <- pair_dist(cs_pairs, pca)

  all_idx <- seq_len(nrow(pca))
  rand_pairs <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_pairs, ncol = 2)
  for (k in seq_len(n_pairs)) {
    rand_pairs[k,] <- sample(all_idx, 2)
  }
  d_rand <- pair_dist(rand_pairs, pca)

  cat("Within-clone:       ", round(mean(d_within),  3), "+/-", round(sd(d_within),  3), "\n")
  cat("Between-clone:      ", round(mean(d_between), 3), "+/-", round(sd(d_between), 3), "\n")
  cat("Singleton-Singleton:", round(mean(d_ss),      3), "+/-", round(sd(d_ss),      3), "\n")
  cat("Clone-Singleton:    ", round(mean(d_cs),      3), "+/-", round(sd(d_cs),      3), "\n")
  cat("Random:             ", round(mean(d_rand),    3), "+/-", round(sd(d_rand),    3), "\n")

  dist_df <- data.frame(
    distance   = c(d_within, d_between, d_ss, d_cs, d_rand),
    comparison = rep(c("Within-clone", "Between-clone",
                       "Singleton-Singleton", "Clone-Singleton", "Random"),
                     each = n_pairs)
  )
  dist_df$comparison <- factor(dist_df$comparison,
                                levels = c("Within-clone", "Between-clone",
                                           "Singleton-Singleton",
                                           "Clone-Singleton", "Random"))
  dist_df
}

barcode.dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/barcode/")
dir.create(barcode.dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

dist_all <- compute_distance_df(seurat_obj, restrict_cluster = NULL)
write.csv(dist_all, paste0(barcode.dir, "figure4_panelE_dist_all.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

dist_c1 <- compute_distance_df(seurat_obj, restrict_cluster = 1)
write.csv(dist_c1, paste0(barcode.dir, "figure4_panelE_dist_c1.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

### Panel H: ICC

Prerequisites: the `### Panel E distances + clone coherence setup` chunk above
(`seurat_obj` with `barcode` and `clone_size`).

ICC is the per-gene intraclass correlation from a one-way random effects model
with clone as the random effect: the fraction of a gene's variance that sits
between clones rather than within them.

```{r}
set.seed(42)

MIN_DETECTION       <- 0.05   # gene must be detected in >= 5% of clone cells
N_ICC_PERMUTATIONS  <- 100    # clone-label shuffles for each ICC null
ICC_MIN             <- 0.10   # effect-size floor: >= 10% of variance between clones

barcode.dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/barcode/")
coherence.dir <- paste0(barcode.dir, "coherence_alternatives/")
dir.create(coherence.dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

clone_meta <- seurat_obj@meta.data %>%
  filter(!is.na(barcode), barcode != "none", clone_size >= 2)

clone_cells   <- clone_meta$cellID
clone_id      <- factor(clone_meta$barcode)
clone_cluster <- factor(clone_meta$seurat_clusters)

cat("Clones with >= 2 cells:", nlevels(clone_id),
    "| cells in those clones:", length(clone_cells),
    "| clusters:", nlevels(clone_cluster), "\n")

expression_sparse <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, layer = "data")[, clone_cells]

detection_rate_clone <- Matrix::rowMeans(expression_sparse > 0)
coherence_genes <- names(detection_rate_clone)[detection_rate_clone >= MIN_DETECTION]

clone_expression <- as.matrix(expression_sparse[coherence_genes, , drop = FALSE])
rm(expression_sparse); gc()

compute_icc <- function(expr, groups) {
  n_total  <- ncol(expr)
  n_groups <- nlevels(groups)
  group_n  <- as.numeric(table(groups))

  indicator   <- Matrix::sparse.model.matrix(~ groups - 1)
  group_sums  <- as.matrix(expr %*% indicator)
  group_means <- sweep(group_sums, 2, group_n, "/")

  grand_mean <- rowMeans(expr)
  ss_total   <- rowSums(expr^2) - n_total * grand_mean^2
  ss_between <- rowSums(sweep(group_means^2, 2, group_n, "*")) -
                n_total * grand_mean^2
  ss_within  <- ss_total - ss_between

  ss_between[ss_between < 0] <- 0
  ss_within[ss_within  < 0]  <- 0

  ms_between <- ss_between / (n_groups - 1)
  ms_within  <- ss_within  / (n_total - n_groups)

  n0 <- (n_total - sum(group_n^2) / n_total) / (n_groups - 1)

  icc <- (ms_between - ms_within) / (ms_between + (n0 - 1) * ms_within)
  icc[!is.finite(icc)] <- NA_real_

  f_stat <- ms_between / ms_within
  f_stat[!is.finite(f_stat)] <- NA_real_

  list(icc      = icc,
       f_stat   = f_stat,
       f_pvalue = pf(f_stat, df1 = n_groups - 1, df2 = n_total - n_groups,
                     lower.tail = FALSE))
}

icc_observed <- compute_icc(clone_expression, clone_id)

# The global null shuffles clone labels across all clone cells. It destroys
# clone identity and cluster composition together, so a gene scores against it
# whenever clonemates resemble each other for any reason (e.g. cell type).
#
# The cluster-matched null permutes labels only among cells within the same
# Seurat cluster. Thus the only thing scrambled is which particular cells are
# clonemates. A gene that survives this null is coherent beyond what
# shared cell state explains.
permute_within_strata <- function(labels, strata) {
  shuffled <- labels
  for (level in levels(strata)) {
    idx <- which(strata == level)
    if (length(idx) > 1) shuffled[idx] <- sample(labels[idx])
  }
  shuffled
}

run_icc_null <- function(permute_fun) {
  null_matrix <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow(clone_expression),
                        ncol = N_ICC_PERMUTATIONS,
                        dimnames = list(rownames(clone_expression), NULL))
  for (i in seq_len(N_ICC_PERMUTATIONS)) {
    null_matrix[, i] <- compute_icc(clone_expression,
                                    factor(permute_fun()))$icc
  }
  null_matrix
}

icc_null <- run_icc_null(function() sample(clone_id))
icc_cluster_null <- run_icc_null(function()
  permute_within_strata(clone_id, clone_cluster))

summarise_null <- function(null_matrix) {
  null_mean <- rowMeans(null_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)
  null_sd   <- matrixStats::rowSds(null_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)
  zscore    <- (icc_observed$icc - null_mean) / null_sd
  zscore[!is.finite(zscore)] <- NA_real_
  list(mean   = null_mean,
       zscore = zscore,
       pvalue = rowSums(null_matrix >= icc_observed$icc, na.rm = TRUE) /
                N_ICC_PERMUTATIONS)
}

icc_global_summary  <- summarise_null(icc_null)
icc_cluster_summary <- summarise_null(icc_cluster_null)

coherence_df <- data.frame(
  gene                    = rownames(clone_expression),
  detection_rate          = detection_rate_clone[rownames(clone_expression)],
  icc                     = icc_observed$icc,
  icc_f_pvalue            = icc_observed$f_pvalue,
  icc_null_mean           = icc_global_summary$mean,
  icc_zscore              = icc_global_summary$zscore,
  icc_perm_pvalue         = icc_global_summary$pvalue,
  icc_cluster_null_mean   = icc_cluster_summary$mean,
  icc_cluster_zscore      = icc_cluster_summary$zscore,
  icc_cluster_pvalue      = icc_cluster_summary$pvalue,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

coherence_df$icc_f_padj       <- p.adjust(coherence_df$icc_f_pvalue,       method = "BH")
coherence_df$icc_perm_padj    <- p.adjust(coherence_df$icc_perm_pvalue,    method = "BH")
coherence_df$icc_cluster_padj <- p.adjust(coherence_df$icc_cluster_pvalue, method = "BH")


coherence_df$icc_coherent <- !is.na(coherence_df$icc_perm_padj) &
                             coherence_df$icc_perm_padj < 0.05 &
                             coherence_df$icc >= ICC_MIN

coherence_df$icc_coherent_cluster <- !is.na(coherence_df$icc_cluster_padj) &
                                     coherence_df$icc_cluster_padj < 0.05 &
                                     coherence_df$icc >= ICC_MIN

coherence_df$icc_excess <- coherence_df$icc - coherence_df$icc_cluster_null_mean
coherence_df$icc_state_fraction <- coherence_df$icc_cluster_null_mean /
                                   coherence_df$icc
coherence_df$icc_state_fraction[!is.finite(coherence_df$icc_state_fraction)] <-
  NA_real_

write.csv(coherence_df, paste0(coherence.dir, "figure4_panelH_icc.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
saveRDS(list(global = icc_null, cluster = icc_cluster_null),
        paste0(coherence.dir, "figure4_panelH_icc_null.rds"))

cat("ICC coherent, global null (FDR < 0.05 & ICC >=", ICC_MIN, "):",
    sum(coherence_df$icc_coherent), "\n")
cat("ICC coherent, cluster-matched null:",
    sum(coherence_df$icc_coherent_cluster), "\n")

cat("\nMedian ICC under each null: global",
    round(median(coherence_df$icc_null_mean, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    "| cluster-matched",
    round(median(coherence_df$icc_cluster_null_mean, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    "| observed", round(median(coherence_df$icc, na.rm = TRUE), 4), "\n")

cat("Median fraction of ICC attributable to cluster structure, coherent genes:",
    round(median(coherence_df$icc_state_fraction[coherence_df$icc_coherent],
                 na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")

cat("\nMost lineage-specific coherent genes (largest ICC excess over the",
    "cluster-matched null):\n")
print(coherence_df %>%
        filter(icc_coherent) %>%
        arrange(desc(icc_excess)) %>%
        select(gene, icc, icc_cluster_null_mean, icc_excess, icc_state_fraction) %>%
        head(15))
```

Prerequisites: the `## Extraction` chunks above, and the memoryseq tables
under `LD002/memoryseq/`.

Data loading.

```{r}
barcode.dir   <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/barcode/")
combined.dir  <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/combined/")
memoryseq.dir <- paste0(data.root, "LD002/memoryseq/")

combined_data           <- read.csv(paste0(combined.dir, "dataframes/GFP_invitro_all_gated.csv"))
```

### Panel C

Prerequisites: the `### Panel C abundance` chunk above.

```{r}
plot_list <- lapply(sort(unique(abundance_per_threshold$threshold)), function(thr) {
  abundance <- abundance_per_threshold %>% filter(threshold == thr)
  r_squared <- cor(abundance$lib1_abundance, abundance$lib2_abundance)^2

  ggplot(abundance, aes(x = lib2_abundance, y = lib1_abundance)) +
    geom_bin2d() +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("black", "blue", "purple", "red", "yellow"),
                         name = "Number of\nBarcodes",
                         trans = "log10") +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_y_log10() +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5,
             label = paste0("R^2 == ", round(r_squared, 3)), parse = TRUE) +
    labs(x = "Barcode abundance\nlibrary 2",
         y = "Barcode abundance\nlibrary 1",
         title = paste0("threshold > ", thr)) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
})

combined <- wrap_plots(plot_list, nrow = 1)
ggsave(paste0(output.dir, "PanelC_barcode_overlap_thresholds.pdf"),
       combined, width = 4 * length(plot_list), height = 4)
```

### Panel D: barcode UMAPs

Prerequisites: the `## Plotting` data-loading chunk above (`combined_data`).

UMAP coordinates, leiden cluster, and lineage barcode all come straight from
`combined_data`. Clone size is the number of cells sharing a barcode; unbarcoded
("none") cells get NA and form the gray background in the clone panels.

```{r}
umap_dataframe <- combined_data %>%
  select(cellID, UMAP1, UMAP2, cluster, barcode) %>%
  mutate(cluster = factor(cluster))

clone_sizes <- umap_dataframe %>%
  filter(barcode != "none") %>%
  count(barcode, name = "clone_size")

umap_dataframe <- umap_dataframe %>%
  left_join(clone_sizes, by = "barcode") %>%
  mutate(clone_size = ifelse(barcode == "none", NA_integer_, clone_size))

singletons <- umap_dataframe %>% filter(clone_size == 1)

# Shared base styling and a faint all-cell background layer.
style_umap <- function(plot, title) {
  plot +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = element_blank()) +
    labs(x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2", title = title)
}

background_layer <- function() {
  geom_point(data = umap_dataframe, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2),
             color = "gray85", size = 0.4, shape = 16)
}

# 1. Color by leiden cluster.
plot_clusters <- style_umap(
  ggplot(umap_dataframe, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = cluster)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.5, shape = 16) +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Leiden\ncluster"),
  "Leiden clusters")

# Color cells in clones of size >= minimum_size by clone identity (relabeled
# clone 1..N by descending size); every other cell stays gray. Legend is shown
# only when there are few enough clones to read it.
plot_clones_min_size <- function(minimum_size, title, show_legend = FALSE) {
  highlight <- umap_dataframe %>%
    filter(!is.na(clone_size), clone_size >= minimum_size)
  clone_order <- highlight %>%
    count(barcode, name = "size") %>%
    arrange(desc(size))
  ordered_barcodes <- clone_order$barcode
  clone_labels <- sprintf("clone %d (n=%d)",
                          seq_along(ordered_barcodes), clone_order$size)
  highlight <- highlight %>%
    mutate(clone = factor(barcode, levels = ordered_barcodes,
                          labels = clone_labels))

  plot <- ggplot() +
    background_layer() +
    geom_point(data = highlight, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = clone),
               size = 0.8, shape = 16) +
    guides(color = if (show_legend) guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2))
                   else "none")
  if (!show_legend) plot <- plot + scale_color_discrete(guide = "none")
  style_umap(plot, sprintf("%s  (%d clones, %d cells)",
                           title, length(ordered_barcodes), nrow(highlight)))
}

# 2. All clones size >= 2 (too many clones for a legend).
plot_clones_ge2 <- plot_clones_min_size(2, "Clones (size >= 2)",
                                        show_legend = FALSE)

# 3. All clones size > 50.
plot_clones_ge50 <- plot_clones_min_size(51, "Clones (size > 50)",
                                         show_legend = TRUE)

# 4. All singletons in a single gray.
plot_singletons <- style_umap(
  ggplot() +
    background_layer() +
    geom_point(data = singletons, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2),
               color = "gray30", size = 0.6, shape = 16),
  sprintf("Singletons (n = %d)", nrow(singletons)))

# 5. Density of singletons with filled density + contour lines.
plot_singleton_density <- style_umap(
  ggplot(singletons, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2)) +
    geom_point(data = umap_dataframe, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2),
               color = "gray90", size = 0.4, shape = 16) +
    geom_density_2d_filled(alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_density_2d(color = "gray20", linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Density"),
  sprintf("Singleton density (n = %d)", nrow(singletons)))

plot_list <- list(plot_clusters, plot_clones_ge2, plot_clones_ge50,
                  plot_singletons, plot_singleton_density)
file_names <- c("PanelD_UMAP_clusters.pdf",
                "PanelD_UMAP_clones_ge2.pdf",
                "PanelD_UMAP_clones_ge50.pdf",
                "PanelD_UMAP_singletons.pdf",
                "PanelD_UMAP_singleton_density.pdf")
for (i in seq_along(plot_list)) {
  ggsave(paste0(output.dir, file_names[i]), plot_list[[i]],
         width = 5, height = 5)
  print(plot_list[[i]])
}

combined_umaps <- wrap_plots(plot_list, nrow = 1)
ggsave(paste0(output.dir, "PanelD_UMAP_barcode_combined.pdf"),
       combined_umaps, width = 5 * length(plot_list), height = 5)
```

### Panel E and Supp Fig 4A

Prerequisites: the `### Panel E distances` chunk above.

```{r}

# Plot only the requested comparison categories, with a Wilcoxon test drawn
# between every pairing of them (all pairwise combinations).
plot_distance_violins <- function(dist_df, categories, output_path) {
  df <- dist_df %>%
    filter(comparison %in% categories) %>%
    mutate(comparison = factor(comparison, levels = categories))
  comparisons_list <- combn(categories, 2, simplify = FALSE)

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = comparison, y = distance)) +
    geom_violin(fill = "gray80") +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1) +
    stat_compare_means(comparisons = comparisons_list,
                       method = "wilcox.test",
                       label = "p.signif",
                       step.increase = 0.08) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(x = "", y = "Euclidean distance (PCA space)") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1))

  ggsave(output_path, p)
  print(p)
  invisible(p)
}

# Clonal lineage: within-barcode vs between-barcode vs random.
plot_distance_violins(dist_all,
                      c("Within-clone", "Between-clone", "Random"),
                      paste0(output.dir, "PanelE_edist_violins_clone.pdf"))

# Singleton context: singleton-singleton vs clone-singleton vs random.
plot_distance_violins(dist_all,
                      c("Singleton-Singleton", "Clone-Singleton", "Random"),
                      paste0(supp_output.dir, "PanelA_edist_violins_singleton.pdf"))
# plot_distance_violins(dist_c1, c("Within-clone", "Between-clone", "Random"),
#                       paste0(supp_output.dir, "PanelESupp_edist_violins_cluster1.pdf"))
```

### Panel H: ICC

Prerequisites: the data loading chunk

```{r}
ICC_MIN     <- 0.10   # must match the ICC extraction chunk
ICC_FDR_MAX <- 0.05

icc_plot_df <- coherence_df %>% filter(!is.na(icc), !is.na(icc_zscore))

n_top_labels <- 25
genes_to_label <- c("IL7R",
                    "APOBEC3G", "APOBEC3H", "SAMHD1",
                    "BST2", "SERINC5", "SERINC3", "MX2",      # restriction factors
                    "CD4", "CCR5", "CCNT1", "NFKB1", "RELA",
                    "PSIP1", "SP1", "CDK9")                   # host factors

top_coherent_genes <- icc_plot_df %>%
  filter(icc_coherent) %>%
  arrange(desc(icc)) %>%
  head(n_top_labels) %>%
  pull(gene)

label_genes <- union(top_coherent_genes, genes_to_label)
label_df    <- icc_plot_df %>% filter(gene %in% label_genes)

# The permutation p-value is floored at 1 / N_ICC_PERMUTATIONS and the coherent
# genes all sit on that floor, so significance is drawn as the permutation
# z-score, which stays continuous. The vertical line is the ICC effect-size
# floor; a called gene must be right of it and significant against the null.
p_icc <- ggplot(icc_plot_df, aes(x = icc, y = icc_zscore)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = icc_coherent), size = 0.5, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = ICC_MIN, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  geom_text_repel(data = label_df, aes(label = gene),
                  size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 20, segment.size = 0.3,
                  min.segment.length = 0, box.padding = 0.3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#EC008C", "FALSE" = "gray70"),
                     labels = c("TRUE" = "Coherent", "FALSE" = "Not called")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Clone ICC (fraction of variance between clones)",
    y = "Permutation z-score (clone-label shuffle null)",
    title = "Clonal coherence of gene expression",
    subtitle = sprintf("Coherent: permutation FDR < %.2f & ICC >= %.2f (%d/%d genes)",
                       ICC_FDR_MAX, ICC_MIN,
                       sum(icc_plot_df$icc_coherent),
                       nrow(icc_plot_df)),
    color = ""
  )
print(p_icc)
ggsave(p_icc, file = paste0(output.dir, "PanelH_icc.pdf"),
       device = "pdf", width = 6, height = 6)
```

### Panel J: heritable vs ICC-coherent genes

Prerequisites: data-loading chunk, ICC extraction chunk, and run the following:

    submissionScripts/Figure4/memoryseq_nfcore_rnaseq.sh
    submissionScripts/Figure4/memoryseq_variability.sh


```{r}
set.seed(42)

N_OVERLAP_PERMUTATIONS <- 10000
N_DETECTION_BINS       <- 10

heritable_genes  <- unique(heritable_df$GeneSymbol)
icc_universe     <- coherence_df$gene
icc_coherent_set <- coherence_df$gene[coherence_df$icc_coherent]
heritable_tested <- intersect(heritable_genes, icc_universe)

observed_overlap <- length(intersect(icc_coherent_set, heritable_tested))

N <- length(icc_universe)
K <- length(icc_coherent_set)
n <- length(heritable_tested)

cat(sprintf("Universe %d | ICC-coherent %d | heritable %d | overlap %d\n",
            N, K, n, observed_overlap))

# Note: clonal expansion is human (GRCh38) and barcode is macaque (Mmul_10)
cat(sprintf("LD002 heritable genes: %d called, %d in the ICC universe (%d dropped)\n",
            length(heritable_genes), n, length(heritable_genes) - n))

detection_bin <- cut(coherence_df$detection_rate,
                     breaks = quantile(coherence_df$detection_rate,
                                       probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = N_DETECTION_BINS + 1),
                                       na.rm = TRUE),
                     include.lowest = TRUE, labels = FALSE)
names(detection_bin) <- coherence_df$gene

genes_by_bin  <- split(coherence_df$gene, detection_bin)
heritable_bin_counts <- table(factor(detection_bin[heritable_tested],
                                     levels = seq_len(N_DETECTION_BINS)))

cat("Heritable genes per detection decile:",
    paste(as.vector(heritable_bin_counts), collapse = " "), "\n")

sample_matched <- function() {
  unlist(lapply(seq_len(N_DETECTION_BINS), function(b) {
    k <- heritable_bin_counts[[b]]
    if (k == 0) return(character(0))
    sample(genes_by_bin[[as.character(b)]], k)
  }), use.names = FALSE)
}

matched_null <- replicate(N_OVERLAP_PERMUTATIONS,
  length(intersect(sample_matched(), icc_coherent_set)))

matched_p <- (sum(matched_null >= observed_overlap) + 1) /
             (N_OVERLAP_PERMUTATIONS + 1)

cat(sprintf("Detection-matched null:  mean %.1f, %.2fx, perm p = %.4g\n",
            mean(matched_null), observed_overlap / mean(matched_null), matched_p))

p_overlap_null <- ggplot(data.frame(overlap = matched_null), aes(x = overlap)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, boundary = -0.5, fill = "gray60",
                 alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = observed_overlap, color = "hotpink",
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Heritable / ICC-coherent overlap", y = "Permutations",
       title = "Heritable vs ICC-coherent genes, detection-matched null",
       subtitle = sprintf("Observed = %d (pink dashed); %.2fx enrichment, permutation p = %.3g",
                          observed_overlap,
                          observed_overlap / mean(matched_null), matched_p))
print(p_overlap_null)
ggsave(p_overlap_null, file = paste0(output.dir, "PanelJ_overlap_null.pdf"),
       device = "pdf", width = 7, height = 5)

overlap_genes_icc <- coherence_df %>%
  filter(gene %in% intersect(icc_coherent_set, heritable_tested)) %>%
  arrange(desc(icc)) %>%
  pull(gene)
cat("Heritable & ICC-coherent genes:\n")
print(overlap_genes_icc)
```

### Panel H supplement: cluster-matched null

Prerequisites: `coherence_df` from the `### Panel H: ICC` chunk above. Genes are labelled
by ICC rank, plus the same restriction- and host-factor panel used for Panel H.
```{r}
coherence_output.dir <- paste0(output.dir, "coherence_alternatives/")
dir.create(coherence_output.dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ICC_MIN <- 0.10   # must match the ICC extraction chunk

coherence_plot_df <- coherence_df %>% filter(!is.na(icc))

coherence_label_genes <- union(
  coherence_plot_df %>% arrange(desc(icc)) %>% head(20) %>% pull(gene),
  c("IL7R", "APOBEC3G", "APOBEC3H", "SAMHD1", "BST2", "SERINC5", "SERINC3",
    "MX2", "CD4", "CCR5", "CCNT1", "NFKB1", "RELA", "PSIP1", "SP1", "CDK9")
)
coherence_label_df <- coherence_plot_df %>%
  filter(gene %in% coherence_label_genes)

# 1. What the cluster-matched null costs. Its mean ICC is the coherence a gene
# gets for free from clonemates sharing a cluster; the distance above the
# diagonal is what clone identity adds on top of cell state.
p_icc_cluster_null <- ggplot(coherence_df,
                             aes(x = icc_cluster_null_mean, y = icc)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = icc_coherent_cluster), size = 0.5, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = ICC_MIN, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray40") +
  geom_text_repel(data = coherence_label_df, aes(label = gene),
                  size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 20, segment.size = 0.3,
                  min.segment.length = 0, box.padding = 0.3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "steelblue", "FALSE" = "gray70"),
                     labels = c("TRUE" = "Coherent", "FALSE" = "Not called")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1) +
  labs(x = "Mean ICC under the cluster-matched null",
       y = "Observed ICC",
       title = "Clone identity vs shared cell state",
       subtitle = sprintf("Cluster-matched null median ICC = %.4f vs global null %.4f",
                          median(coherence_df$icc_cluster_null_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
                          median(coherence_df$icc_null_mean, na.rm = TRUE)),
       color = "")
print(p_icc_cluster_null)
ggsave(p_icc_cluster_null,
       file = paste0(coherence_output.dir, "PanelH_icc_cluster_null.pdf"),
       device = "pdf", width = 6, height = 6)

# 2. p-value resolution. The ICC permutation test cannot return a p-value below
# 1 / N_ICC_PERMUTATIONS, so its significant genes pile up at a single value,
# which is why Panel H plots the permutation z-score instead.
pvalue_df <- bind_rows(
  coherence_plot_df %>% transmute(pvalue = icc_perm_pvalue,
                                  method = "ICC permutation (global null)"),
  coherence_plot_df %>% transmute(pvalue = icc_cluster_pvalue,
                                  method = "ICC permutation (cluster-matched)")
)

p_pvalue_resolution <- ggplot(pvalue_df, aes(x = pvalue)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "gray70") +
  facet_wrap(~ method, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "p-value", y = "Genes",
       title = "p-value resolution by method",
       subtitle = "Permutation tests are floored at 1 / n_permutations")
print(p_pvalue_resolution)
ggsave(p_pvalue_resolution,
       file = paste0(coherence_output.dir, "PanelH_pvalue_resolution.pdf"),
       device = "pdf", width = 9, height = 4)

cat("Method agreement:\n")
print(table(`ICC global null` = coherence_plot_df$icc_coherent,
            `ICC cluster-matched` = coherence_plot_df$icc_coherent_cluster))
```


# Host targets
## Extraction

### BRIE

Prerequisite: run BRIE2 via `extractionScripts/submissionScripts/Figure4/brie2.sh`

```{r}
brie.dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/singleCell/BRIE2/invitro/")

brie <- read.csv(paste0(brie.dir, "brie2_per_cell.csv"))

brie_wide <- brie %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = cellID,
    names_from  = event,
    values_from = c(isoform1, isoform2, psi),
    values_fill = list(isoform1 = 0, isoform2 = 0)
  ) %>%
  rename_with(~ sub("^isoform1_", "", .) %>% paste0("_in_BRIE"),  starts_with("isoform1_")) %>%
  rename_with(~ sub("^isoform2_", "", .) %>% paste0("_out_BRIE"), starts_with("isoform2_")) %>%
  rename_with(~ sub("^psi_",      "", .) %>% paste0("_psi_BRIE"), starts_with("psi_"))

combined.dir  <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/combined/")
combined_data <- read.csv(paste0(combined.dir, "dataframes/GFP_invitro_all_gated.csv"))

combined_with_brie <- left_join(combined_data, brie_wide, by = "cellID")
cat("Cells in combined_data:", nrow(combined_data))
```

### Host CaRe

Prerequisites: `extractionScripts/submissionScripts/Figure4/stepTwo_bamsort.sh` on host genes, and the BRIE chunk above for
`combined_with_brie`.

```{r}
alignment.dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/CaRe/stepTwo/alignment/")
processed.dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/CaRe/stepTwo/processed/")

samples <- c("PTPRC", "BCL2L1", "IL7R")

cat_map <- list(
  PTPRC  = c("PTPRC_exon4", "PTPRC_exon4_exclusion"),
  IL7R   = c("IL7R_exon6_TM", "IL7R_exon6_TM_exclusion"),
  BCL2L1 = c("BCL2L1")
)

# Loading raw alignment rows for QC
care_data <- bind_rows(lapply(samples, function(s) {
  files <- list.files(alignment.dir,
                      pattern = paste0("^", s, "_bamsort_alignment_.*\\.csv$"),
                      full.names = TRUE)
  bind_rows(lapply(files, function(f) {
    df <- read.csv(f)
    if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
    df$sample <- s
    df$target <- sub("^.*_bamsort_alignment_(.*)\\.csv$", "\\1", basename(f))
    df
  }))
}))

bamsort_stats <- bind_rows(lapply(samples, function(s) {
  f <- paste0(alignment.dir, s, "_alignment_summary.txt")
  if (file.exists(f)) read.csv(f) else NULL
}))
cat("Loaded ", nrow(bamsort_stats), " summary rows\n",
    nrow(care_data), " UMI x cellID x target rows across ",
    length(unique(care_data$sample)), " samples\n", sep = "")

# minimums
minimum.dir <- paste0(processed.dir, "minimum/")
process_all_set_minimums(
  mode        = "host",
  sample_list = samples,
  input_dir   = processed.dir,
  save_output = TRUE,
  output_dir  = minimum.dir,
  min_reads   = 2,   # >= 2 reads/UMI; drops single-read UMIs
  min_umi     = 1
)


# joining: pull all needed category columns per gene from host_filtered.csv
care_per_target <- lapply(samples, function(s) {
  f <- paste0(minimum.dir, s, "_host_filtered.csv")
  if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)
  df <- read.csv(f)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  cats <- cat_map[[s]]
  missing <- setdiff(cats, colnames(df))
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    warning(sprintf("Sample %s: missing categories %s -- filling with 0",
                    s, paste(missing, collapse = ", ")))
    df[missing] <- 0
  }
  df[, c("cellID", cats), drop = FALSE]
})
care_per_target <- Filter(Negate(is.null), care_per_target)

care_wide <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = "cellID", all = TRUE),
                     care_per_target)
care_wide[is.na(care_wide)] <- 0

# Per-cell binary splice calls: exon included (inclusion UMIs) vs exon
# excluded (UMIs with N-gap spanning the cassette). For PTPRC, A_out
# aggregates every skip-A splice path -- RB, RC, RBC, RO -- aka "RA-negative"
care_wide <- care_wide %>%
  mutate(
    PTPRC_A_in_CaRe  = PTPRC_exon4,
    PTPRC_A_out_CaRe = PTPRC_exon4_exclusion,
    IL7R_TM_in_CaRe  = IL7R_exon6_TM,
    IL7R_TM_out_CaRe = IL7R_exon6_TM_exclusion,
    BCL2L1_CaRe      = BCL2L1
  ) %>%
  select(cellID, ends_with("_CaRe"))

integrated <- combined_with_brie %>%
  left_join(care_wide, by = "cellID") %>%
  mutate(across(ends_with("_CaRe"), ~ ifelse(is.na(.x), 0, .x)))

save_dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/joint/integrated/")
dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(integrated,
          paste0(save_dir, "GFP_invitro_integrated_host_CaRe.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

care_cols <- grep("_CaRe$", colnames(integrated), value = TRUE)
cat("Integrated table:", nrow(integrated), "cells x ", ncol(integrated), "columns\n")
cat("Cells CaRe+ for any isoform column:",
    sum(rowSums(integrated[, care_cols, drop = FALSE] > 0) > 0), "\n")
for (col in care_cols) {
  cat(sprintf("  %s+ cells: %d\n", col, sum(integrated[[col]] > 0)))
}
```


### Host gene expression per cell

Prerequisite: the Seurat object. Writes per-cell IL7R gene counts, the
denominator and x-axis for the Panel K sensitivity curve. The RDS is ~1.2 GB, so
this chunk is run on a compute node (srun, genomics partition) rather than the
login node.

```{r}
rds.dir        <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/singleCell/Seurat/RDS/")
integrated.dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/joint/integrated/")

seurat_obj <- readRDS(paste0(rds.dir, "GFP_invitro.rds"))
seurat_obj[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(seurat_obj[["RNA"]])
il7r_counts <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")["IL7R", ]
rm(seurat_obj); invisible(gc())

write.csv(data.frame(cellID = names(il7r_counts),
                     IL7R_GEX = as.numeric(il7r_counts)),
          paste0(integrated.dir, "il7r_GEX_percell.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

            length(il7r_counts), sum(il7r_counts > 0)))
```
