### Panel F: PTPRC isoform recovery — TenX vs Ca*Re

Prerequisite: the host-target extraction in Figure4
(`process_all_set_minimums`, mode "host", `min_reads = 2`) regenerated
`PTPRC_host_filtered.csv`; BRIE2 run on the TenX library (`extractionScripts/submissionScripts/Figure4/brie2.sh`).

```{r}
integrated.dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/joint/integrated/")
care.dir      <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/CaRe/stepTwo/processed/minimum/")
combined.dir   <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/combined/")
umi.file       <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/",
                         "CaRe/stepTwo/processed/PTPRC_UMI_read_counts_full.csv")

isoform_levels    <- c("RA", "RB", "RC", "RO")
MIN_READS_PER_UMI <- 2

ptprc_tenx <- read.csv(paste0(integrated.dir, "ptprc_GEX_percell.csv"))

# RO molecules exclude all three cassettes A, B, and C
ptprc_ro <- read.csv(umi.file) %>%
  filter(read_count >= MIN_READS_PER_UMI) %>%
  group_by(cellID, UMI) %>%
  summarise(is_RO = any(category == "PTPRC_exon4_exclusion") &
                    any(category == "PTPRC_exon5_exclusion") &
                    any(category == "PTPRC_exon6_exclusion"),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(is_RO) %>%
  count(cellID, name = "RO")

ptprc_care <- read.csv(paste0(care.dir, "PTPRC_host_filtered.csv")) %>%
  mutate(RA = PTPRC_exon4, RB = PTPRC_exon5, RC = PTPRC_exon6) %>%
  left_join(ptprc_ro, by = "cellID") %>%
  mutate(RO = ifelse(is.na(RO), 0, RO))

analysis_cells <- read.csv(paste0(combined.dir, "dataframes/GFP_invitro_all_gated.csv"))$cellID
ptprc_tenx   <- ptprc_tenx   %>% filter(cellID %in% analysis_cells)
ptprc_care <- ptprc_care %>% filter(cellID %in% analysis_cells)
cat(sprintf("Analysis cells %d | TenX table %d | Ca*Re %d\n",
            length(analysis_cells), nrow(ptprc_tenx), nrow(ptprc_care)))

brie.dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/singleCell/BRIE2/invitro/")
brie_events <- read.csv(paste0(brie.dir, "brie2_per_cell.csv")) %>%
  filter(grepl("^PTPRC_", event))

ptprc_brie <- brie_events %>%
  group_by(cellID) %>%
  summarise(brie_umis = sum(isoform1 + isoform2, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(cellID %in% analysis_cells)

# RO is cell-level for BRIE2
ptprc_brie_iso <- brie_events %>%
  select(cellID, event, isoform1, isoform2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = event, values_from = c(isoform1, isoform2),
              values_fill = 0) %>%
  transmute(cellID,
            RA = isoform1_PTPRC_exon4,
            RB = isoform1_PTPRC_exon5,
            RC = isoform1_PTPRC_exon6,
            RO = as.integer(isoform2_PTPRC_exon4 > 0 &
                            isoform2_PTPRC_exon5 > 0 &
                            isoform2_PTPRC_exon6 > 0)) %>%
  filter(cellID %in% analysis_cells)

resolved <- list(
  "TenX" = ptprc_brie$cellID[ptprc_brie$brie_umis > 0],
  "Ca*Re"       = ptprc_care$cellID[rowSums(ptprc_care[, isoform_levels]) > 0])

ptprc_pos_ids <- ptprc_tenx$cellID[ptprc_tenx$PTPRC_GEX > 0]
n_ptprc_pos   <- length(ptprc_pos_ids)

bar_df <- bind_rows(lapply(names(resolved), function(m) {
  n <- sum(ptprc_pos_ids %in% resolved[[m]])
  ci <- binom.test(n, n_ptprc_pos)$conf.int
  data.frame(category = m, n_cells = n, frac = n / n_ptprc_pos,
             ci_lower = ci[1], ci_upper = ci[2])
})) %>%
  mutate(category = factor(category, levels = names(resolved)))
cat(sprintf("PTPRC+ cells (denominator): %d\n", n_ptprc_pos))
print(bar_df)

# McNemar on paired per-cell membership
mcnemar_pair <- function(a, b) {
  tbl <- table(factor(ptprc_pos_ids %in% resolved[[a]], c(FALSE, TRUE)),
               factor(ptprc_pos_ids %in% resolved[[b]], c(FALSE, TRUE)))
  mcnemar.test(tbl)$p.value
}
pairs_df <- as.data.frame(t(combn(names(resolved), 2)),
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  rename(method_a = V1, method_b = V2) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(p_value = mcnemar_pair(method_a, method_b)) %>%
  ungroup()
print(pairs_df)

sig_stars <- function(p) ifelse(p < 1e-4, "****", ifelse(p < 1e-3, "***",
                         ifelse(p < 1e-2, "**", ifelse(p < 0.05, "*", "ns"))))

bracket_base <- max(bar_df$ci_upper) + 0.05
pairs_df <- pairs_df %>%
  mutate(xmin = match(method_a, levels(bar_df$category)),
         xmax = match(method_b, levels(bar_df$category)),
         y_position = bracket_base + 0.07 * (row_number() - 1))

p_bar <- ggplot(bar_df, aes(x = category, y = frac, fill = category)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper),
                width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_signif(annotations = sig_stars(pairs_df$p_value),
              xmin = pairs_df$xmin, xmax = pairs_df$xmax,
              y_position = pairs_df$y_position, tip_length = 0.01,
              textsize = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TenX" = "#2B3990",
                               "Ca*Re"       = "#00AEEF"), guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.0), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "PTPRC\nisoform resolved", y = "Fraction of PTPRC+ cells")
print(p_bar)
ggsave(paste0(output.dir, "PanelF_PTPRC_barplot.pdf"),
       p_bar, width = 3, height = 5)
```

### Panel G: clonal heritability of PTPRC isoform

Prerequisite: the Barcode > Plotting data-loading chunk (`combined_data`) and
the Host targets > Plotting data-loading chunk (`output.dir`).

```{r}
set.seed(42)
dir.create(output.dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

umi.file          <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/",
                            "CaRe/stepTwo/processed/PTPRC_UMI_read_counts_full.csv")
MIN_READS_PER_UMI   <- 2
MIN_CLONE_CELLS     <- 2
N_HERITABILITY_PERM <- 2000

CASSETTES <- c(A = "PTPRC_exon4", C = "PTPRC_exon6")

icc_one_way <- function(values, groups) {
  groups      <- droplevels(factor(groups))
  group_n     <- as.numeric(table(groups))
  n_total     <- length(values)
  n_groups    <- nlevels(groups)
  group_means <- as.numeric(tapply(values, groups, mean))
  grand_mean  <- mean(values)
  ss_between  <- sum(group_n * (group_means - grand_mean)^2)
  ss_within   <- sum((values - grand_mean)^2) - ss_between
  ms_between  <- ss_between / (n_groups - 1)
  ms_within   <- ss_within  / (n_total - n_groups)
  n0 <- (n_total - sum(group_n^2) / n_total) / (n_groups - 1)
  (ms_between - ms_within) / (ms_between + (n0 - 1) * ms_within)
}

permute_within_strata <- function(labels, strata) {
  shuffled <- labels
  for (level in unique(strata)) {
    idx <- which(strata == level)
    if (length(idx) > 1) shuffled[idx] <- sample(labels[idx])
  }
  shuffled
}

ptprc_umi <- read.csv(umi.file) %>% filter(read_count >= MIN_READS_PER_UMI)

# Per-cell splicing state for one cassette, restricted to barcoded cells sitting
# in a clone of at least MIN_CLONE_CELLS informative cells.
cassette_cells <- function(exon) {
  ptprc_umi %>%
    group_by(cellID, UMI) %>%
    summarise(inc = any(category == exon),
              exc = any(category == paste0(exon, "_exclusion")), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(inc | exc) %>%
    group_by(cellID) %>%
    summarise(n_umi = n(), psi = sum(inc) / n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    inner_join(combined_data %>% select(cellID, barcode, cluster), by = "cellID") %>%
    filter(barcode != "none") %>%
    group_by(barcode) %>% filter(n() >= MIN_CLONE_CELLS) %>% ungroup()
}

cassette_heritability <- function(cassette, exon) {
  d <- cassette_cells(exon)
  state_r2 <- summary(lm(psi ~ factor(cluster), data = d))$r.squared
  cat(sprintf("\ncassette %s (%s): %d cells | %d clones | mean psi %.3f | skip+ %.1f%% | psi ~ cluster R2 %.3f\n",
              cassette, exon, nrow(d), n_distinct(d$barcode), mean(d$psi),
              100 * mean(d$psi < 1), state_r2))

  statistics <- list("psi ICC" = function(g) icc_one_way(d$psi, g))
  nulls <- list("Clone-label shuffle"           = function() sample(d$barcode),
                "Shuffle within Leiden cluster" = function()
                  permute_within_strata(d$barcode, d$cluster))

  out <- lapply(names(statistics), function(stat) {
    f   <- statistics[[stat]]
    obs <- f(d$barcode)
    draws <- lapply(nulls, function(permute)
      replicate(N_HERITABILITY_PERM, f(permute())))
    p <- vapply(draws, function(x) (sum(x >= obs) + 1) / (N_HERITABILITY_PERM + 1),
                numeric(1))
    cat(sprintf("  %-17s observed %9.3f | %s\n", stat, obs,
                paste(sprintf("%s p = %.4g", c("global", "cluster-matched"), p),
                      collapse = " | ")))
    list(observed = data.frame(cassette = cassette, statistic = stat, value = obs,
                               p_global = p[[1]], p_cluster = p[[2]]),
         nulls = bind_rows(lapply(names(draws), function(n)
           data.frame(cassette = cassette, statistic = stat,
                      value = draws[[n]], null = n))))
  })

  # Single-UMI cells have psi pinned to 0 or 1, which adds within-clone sampling
  # noise; repeating on >= 2 UMI cells checks psi is not driven by it.
  deep <- d %>% filter(n_umi >= 2) %>%
    group_by(barcode) %>% filter(n() >= MIN_CLONE_CELLS) %>% ungroup()
  if (n_distinct(deep$barcode) >= 5) {
    icc_deep  <- icc_one_way(deep$psi, deep$barcode)
    null_deep <- replicate(N_HERITABILITY_PERM, icc_one_way(deep$psi, sample(deep$barcode)))
    cat(sprintf("  sensitivity, psi on >= 2 UMI cells (%d cells, %d clones): ICC %.3f, p = %.4g\n",
                nrow(deep), n_distinct(deep$barcode), icc_deep,
                (sum(null_deep >= icc_deep) + 1) / (N_HERITABILITY_PERM + 1)))
  }

  # Clones sit largely inside one cluster, so the cluster-matched null removes
  # much of the clone structure along with cell state and is conservative.
  purity <- d %>% group_by(barcode) %>%
    summarise(top = max(table(cluster)) / n(), .groups = "drop")
  cat(sprintf("  clone cluster purity: median %.2f | confined to one cluster %d/%d\n",
              median(purity$top), sum(purity$top == 1), nrow(purity)))

  list(observed = bind_rows(lapply(out, `[[`, "observed")),
       nulls    = bind_rows(lapply(out, `[[`, "nulls")))
}

heritability   <- lapply(names(CASSETTES),
                         function(x) cassette_heritability(x, CASSETTES[[x]]))
stat_observed  <- bind_rows(lapply(heritability, `[[`, "observed"))
stat_nulls     <- bind_rows(lapply(heritability, `[[`, "nulls"))

panel_label <- function(cassette, statistic, p_global, p_cluster)
  sprintf("cassette %s -- %s\nglobal p = %.3f, cluster-matched p = %.3f",
          cassette, statistic, p_global, p_cluster)
label_levels <- with(stat_observed, panel_label(cassette, statistic, p_global, p_cluster))
stat_observed <- stat_observed %>%
  mutate(panel = factor(panel_label(cassette, statistic, p_global, p_cluster),
                        levels = label_levels))
stat_nulls <- stat_nulls %>%
  left_join(stat_observed %>% select(cassette, statistic, panel),
            by = c("cassette", "statistic"))

p_heritability <- ggplot(stat_nulls, aes(x = value, fill = null)) +
  geom_histogram(position = "identity", bins = 45, alpha = 0.6, color = NA) +
  geom_vline(data = stat_observed, aes(xintercept = value),
             color = "#D55E00", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, ncol = 1, scales = "free") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Clone-label shuffle" = "gray70",
                               "Shuffle within Leiden cluster" = "steelblue")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "vertical",
        strip.text = element_text(size = 8)) +
  labs(x = "Clone ICC (psi)", y = "Permutations", fill = NULL,
       title = "Clonal heritability of PTPRC cassette splicing",
       subtitle = "Orange dashed = observed")
print(p_heritability)
ggsave(p_heritability, file = paste0(output.dir, "PanelG_PTPRC_heritability.pdf"),
       device = "pdf", width = 5, height = 7)
```

### Panel K: IL7R isoform detection sensitivity — Ca*Re vs 10X

Prerequisite: run the plotting data-loading chunk (`integrated`, `output.dir`)
and the host gene expression extraction chunk (`il7r_GEX_percell.csv`).

Detection rate against IL7R gene expression, per method. The gain in isoform
recovery is a per-transcript sensitivity gain rather than deeper sampling of
cells 10X already resolves, so the panel plots how much IL7R a cell must express
before each method resolves its isoform. Note the x-axis comes from the same 10X
library BRIE2 calls isoforms from, so a cell with IL7R counts is guaranteed 10X
reads at the locus; that asymmetry favours 10X and makes the gap conservative.

```{r}
integrated.dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/joint/integrated/")
MIN_CELLS_PER_POINT <- 20   # below this an observed detection rate is too noisy to plot

il7r <- integrated %>%
  mutate(care = IL7R_TM_in_CaRe      + IL7R_TM_out_CaRe,
         tenx  = IL7R_exon6_TM_in_BRIE + IL7R_exon6_TM_out_BRIE) %>%
  inner_join(read.csv(paste0(integrated.dir, "il7r_GEX_percell.csv")), by = "cellID")

# --- Isoform recovery, the headline comparison --------------------------------
cat("=== IL7R isoform recovery ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Isoform molecules: Ca*Re %d | 10X (BRIE2) %d | %.1fx\n",
            sum(il7r$care), sum(il7r$tenx), sum(il7r$care) / sum(il7r$tenx)))
cat(sprintf("Cells with isoform resolution: Ca*Re %d | 10X %d | %.1fx (of %d cells)\n",
            sum(il7r$care > 0), sum(il7r$tenx > 0),
            sum(il7r$care > 0) / sum(il7r$tenx > 0), nrow(il7r)))
cat(sprintf("Detection overlap: both %d | Ca*Re-only %d | 10X-only %d\n",
            sum(il7r$care > 0 & il7r$tenx > 0), sum(il7r$care > 0 & il7r$tenx == 0),
            sum(il7r$tenx > 0 & il7r$care == 0)))

# --- Soluble (exon 6 skipped) share of isoforms -------------------------------
cat("\n=== Soluble (TM-out) share of IL7R isoforms ===\n")
for (method in c("Ca*Re", "10X")) {
  out   <- if (method == "Ca*Re") il7r$IL7R_TM_out_CaRe else il7r$IL7R_exon6_TM_out_BRIE
  total <- if (method == "Ca*Re") il7r$care              else il7r$tenx
  cat(sprintf("%-6s soluble %d / %d molecules (%.1f%%) | soluble+ cells %d / %d resolved\n",
              method, sum(out), sum(total), 100 * sum(out) / sum(total),
              sum(out > 0), sum(total > 0)))
}

# --- Molecules per resolved cell: is the gain depth or breadth? ---------------
# If Ca*Re only sampled the same cells more deeply, its resolved cells would
# carry more molecules each. They do not, so the gain is in which cells are
# resolved at all.
care_depth <- il7r$care[il7r$care > 0]
tenx_depth  <- il7r$tenx[il7r$tenx  > 0]
cat("\n=== Isoform molecules per resolved cell ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Ca*Re mean %.2f (median %d) | 10X mean %.2f (median %d) | Wilcoxon p = %.2f, KS p = %.2f\n",
            mean(care_depth), median(care_depth), mean(tenx_depth), median(tenx_depth),
            suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(care_depth, tenx_depth))$p.value,
            suppressWarnings(ks.test(care_depth, tenx_depth))$p.value))

# --- Detection vs IL7R expression ---------------------------------------------
# Restricted to IL7R+ cells: among IL7R-zero cells the few Ca*Re calls are
# single-molecule and flat across clusters, i.e. an ambient signature.
expressing <- il7r %>% filter(IL7R_GEX > 0)

# Half-detection point: transcripts at which a method resolves half of cells.
half_detection <- function(resolved, counts) {
  fit <- glm(resolved ~ log2_counts, family = binomial,
             data = data.frame(resolved = resolved, log2_counts = log2(counts)))
  2 ^ (-coef(fit)[[1]] / coef(fit)[[2]])
}
half_care <- half_detection(expressing$care > 0, expressing$IL7R_GEX)
half_tenx  <- half_detection(expressing$tenx  > 0, expressing$IL7R_GEX)
cat(sprintf("\n=== Detection vs IL7R expression (%d IL7R+ cells) ===\n", nrow(expressing)))
cat(sprintf("Half-detection point: Ca*Re %.1f transcripts | 10X %.1f transcripts | %.1fx lower\n",
            half_care, half_tenx, half_tenx / half_care))

observed <- expressing %>%
  group_by(IL7R_GEX) %>%
  summarise(n_cells = n(), `Ca*Re` = mean(care > 0), `10X` = mean(tenx > 0),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_cells >= MIN_CELLS_PER_POINT) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(`Ca*Re`, `10X`), names_to = "method", values_to = "rate")
cat("\nObserved detection rate by IL7R transcript count:\n")
print(as.data.frame(observed %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = rate) %>%
  mutate(across(c(`Ca*Re`, `10X`), ~ round(.x, 3)))))

# Logistic fits drawn over the plotted range, one per method.
fit_curve <- function(resolved, label) {
  fit  <- glm(resolved ~ log2_counts, family = binomial,
              data = data.frame(resolved = resolved,
                                log2_counts = log2(expressing$IL7R_GEX)))
  grid <- seq(1, max(observed$IL7R_GEX), length.out = 200)
  data.frame(IL7R_GEX = grid, method = label,
             rate = predict(fit, data.frame(log2_counts = log2(grid)),
                            type = "response"))
}
curves <- bind_rows(fit_curve(expressing$care > 0, "Ca*Re"),
                    fit_curve(expressing$tenx  > 0, "10X"))

method_colors <- c("Ca*Re" = "#00AEEF", "10X" = "#2B3990")
half_df <- data.frame(method = c("Ca*Re", "10X"), x = c(half_care, half_tenx))

p_sensitivity <- ggplot(observed, aes(x = IL7R_GEX, y = rate, color = method)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray60",
             linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_segment(data = half_df, inherit.aes = FALSE,
               aes(x = x, xend = x, y = 0, yend = 0.5, color = method),
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = curves, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n_cells)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = method_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 5, name = "Cells") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks()) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1) +
  labs(x = "IL7R transcripts per cell (10X)",
       y = "Cells with IL7R isoform resolution",
       title = "IL7R isoform detection sensitivity",
       subtitle = sprintf("Half-detection: Ca*Re %.1f vs 10X %.1f transcripts",
                          half_care, half_tenx))
print(p_sensitivity)
ggsave(p_sensitivity, file = paste0(output.dir, "PanelK_IL7R_detection_sensitivity.pdf"),
       device = "pdf", width = 5.5, height = 4.5)
```

## In text numbers

Prerequisites: `GFP_invitro_all_gated.csv` and
`GFP_invitro_integrated_host_CaRe.csv` on disk.

```{r}
## Data loading
joint.dir    <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/joint/integrated/")
combined.dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/combined/")

# The host-target artifact, for the isoform read-outs.
integrated <- read.csv(paste0(joint.dir, "GFP_invitro_integrated_host_CaRe.csv"))
# The SIV extraction's own table, for the viral read-outs and the CD4 T call.
# Taking them from here rather than from `integrated` keeps this chunk current
# with the SIV extraction without the host join having to be rebuilt first.
combined_gated <- read.csv(paste0(combined.dir, "dataframes/GFP_invitro_all_gated.csv"))

care_cols <- c("PTPRC_A_in_CaRe", "PTPRC_A_out_CaRe",
                "IL7R_TM_in_CaRe", "IL7R_TM_out_CaRe",
                "BCL2L1_CaRe")

output.dir <- paste0(plot.root, "Figure4/")
dir.create(output.dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

## Print statements
il7r_tab <- integrated %>%
  mutate(across(c(IL7R_exon6_TM_in_BRIE, IL7R_exon6_TM_out_BRIE),
                ~ ifelse(is.na(.x), 0, .x)))

care_in_total     <- sum(il7r_tab$IL7R_TM_in_CaRe)
care_out_total    <- sum(il7r_tab$IL7R_TM_out_CaRe)
care_umis         <- care_in_total + care_out_total
care_resolved     <- (il7r_tab$IL7R_TM_in_CaRe + il7r_tab$IL7R_TM_out_CaRe) > 0
care_cells        <- sum(care_resolved)
care_soluble_frac <- care_out_total / care_umis

brie_in_total     <- sum(il7r_tab$IL7R_exon6_TM_in_BRIE)
brie_out_total    <- sum(il7r_tab$IL7R_exon6_TM_out_BRIE)
brie_umis         <- brie_in_total + brie_out_total
brie_resolved     <- (il7r_tab$IL7R_exon6_TM_in_BRIE + il7r_tab$IL7R_exon6_TM_out_BRIE) > 0
brie_cells        <- sum(brie_resolved)
brie_soluble_frac <- brie_out_total / brie_umis

# --- SIV+ cells---
cd4t_cells <- combined_gated %>%
  filter(cd4t %in% TRUE) %>%
  mutate(siv_pos     = total > 0,
         barcode_pos = barcode != "none")

cat("=== SIV+ cells ===\n")
cat(sprintf("CD4 T gate: %d / %d cells (%d excluded by a lineage marker)\n",
            nrow(cd4t_cells), nrow(combined_gated),
            sum(combined_gated$excluded %in% TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("SIV+ (Ca*Re total > 0): %d / %d CD4 T cells (%.1f%%)\n",
            sum(cd4t_cells$siv_pos), nrow(cd4t_cells), 100 * mean(cd4t_cells$siv_pos)))
cat(sprintf("Barcode+ overall: %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            sum(cd4t_cells$barcode_pos), 100 * mean(cd4t_cells$barcode_pos)))
# The two conditional directions of one 2x2 table, each with its own counts.
cat(sprintf("SIV+ rate:     barcode+ %.2f%% (%d/%d) vs barcode- %.2f%% (%d/%d)\n",
            100 * mean(cd4t_cells$siv_pos[cd4t_cells$barcode_pos]),
            sum(cd4t_cells$siv_pos & cd4t_cells$barcode_pos),
            sum(cd4t_cells$barcode_pos),
            100 * mean(cd4t_cells$siv_pos[!cd4t_cells$barcode_pos]),
            sum(cd4t_cells$siv_pos & !cd4t_cells$barcode_pos),
            sum(!cd4t_cells$barcode_pos)))
cat(sprintf("Barcode+ rate: SIV+ %.1f%% (%d/%d) vs SIV- %.1f%% (%d/%d)\n",
            100 * mean(cd4t_cells$barcode_pos[cd4t_cells$siv_pos]),
            sum(cd4t_cells$barcode_pos & cd4t_cells$siv_pos),
            sum(cd4t_cells$siv_pos),
            100 * mean(cd4t_cells$barcode_pos[!cd4t_cells$siv_pos]),
            sum(cd4t_cells$barcode_pos & !cd4t_cells$siv_pos),
            sum(!cd4t_cells$siv_pos)))

# --- IL7R---
cat("\n=== IL7R isoform resolution (Ca*Re at min_reads >= 2) ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Catch*ReSeq: %d isoform UMIs in %d / %d cells (%.1f%%) | soluble = %.1f%% of isoforms (%d UMIs)\n",
            care_umis, care_cells, nrow(il7r_tab), 100 * care_cells / nrow(il7r_tab),
            100 * care_soluble_frac, care_out_total))
cat(sprintf("TenX (BRIE2): %d isoform UMIs in %d / %d cells (%.1f%%) | soluble = %.1f%% of isoforms (%d UMIs)\n",
            brie_umis, brie_cells, nrow(il7r_tab), 100 * brie_cells / nrow(il7r_tab),
            100 * brie_soluble_frac, brie_out_total))
# The Ca*Re arm is the min_reads >= 2 / min_umi >= 1 host_filtered table that
# process_all_set_minimums writes in the integration chunk. The TenX arm comes
# from BRIE2 and has no such threshold.
cat(sprintf("Recovery gain Catch*ReSeq / TenX: %.1fx isoform UMIs (%d vs %d), %.1fx cells (%d vs %d)\n",
            care_umis / brie_umis, care_umis, brie_umis,
            care_cells / brie_cells, care_cells, brie_cells))
cat(sprintf("Cells resolved by both: %d | Catch*ReSeq only: %d | GEX only: %d (McNemar p = %.3g)\n",
            sum(care_resolved & brie_resolved), sum(care_resolved & !brie_resolved),
            sum(brie_resolved & !care_resolved),
            mcnemar.test(table(care_resolved, brie_resolved))$p.value))

soluble_test <- prop.test(c(care_out_total, brie_out_total), c(care_umis, brie_umis))
cat(sprintf("Soluble fraction Catch*ReSeq %.1f%% vs TenX %.1f%%: prop test p = %.3g\n",
            100 * care_soluble_frac, 100 * brie_soluble_frac, soluble_test$p.value))

# --- Soluble+ co-expression of the membrane isoform ---
# "Well dispersed" means soluble molecules sit in cells that also carry the
# membrane form, rather than in a dedicated soluble-only subpopulation.
care_soluble_pos  <- il7r_tab$IL7R_TM_out_CaRe > 0
care_membrane_pos <- il7r_tab$IL7R_TM_in_CaRe  > 0
cat("\n=== Soluble+ cells also expressing membrane isoform ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Catch*ReSeq: %d / %d soluble+ cells also membrane+ (%.0f%%)\n",
            sum(care_soluble_pos & care_membrane_pos), sum(care_soluble_pos),
            100 * sum(care_soluble_pos & care_membrane_pos) / sum(care_soluble_pos)))

comb_soluble_pos  <- care_soluble_pos  | (il7r_tab$IL7R_exon6_TM_out_BRIE > 0)
comb_membrane_pos <- care_membrane_pos | (il7r_tab$IL7R_exon6_TM_in_BRIE  > 0)
cat(sprintf("Catch*ReSeq | TenX: %d / %d soluble+ cells also membrane+ (%.0f%%)\n",
            sum(comb_soluble_pos & comb_membrane_pos), sum(comb_soluble_pos),
            100 * sum(comb_soluble_pos & comb_membrane_pos) / sum(comb_soluble_pos)))

# Supp Fig 4E gates on pooled depth, where a co-expression call is not forced by
# a one-UMI cell, so report the same gate the panel uses.
depth_cut <- 3
il7r_depth <- il7r_tab %>%
  mutate(count_in  = IL7R_TM_in_CaRe  + IL7R_exon6_TM_in_BRIE,
         count_out = IL7R_TM_out_CaRe + IL7R_exon6_TM_out_BRIE,
         count_total = count_in + count_out) %>%
  filter(count_total >= depth_cut)
cat(sprintf("Pooled, depth >= %d (Supp Fig 4E gate): %d / %d soluble+ cells also membrane+ (%.0f%%) of %d cells\n",
            depth_cut, sum(il7r_depth$count_out > 0 & il7r_depth$count_in > 0),
            sum(il7r_depth$count_out > 0),
            100 * sum(il7r_depth$count_out > 0 & il7r_depth$count_in > 0) /
              sum(il7r_depth$count_out > 0),
            nrow(il7r_depth)))

# --- Soluble+ cells inside clones---
# Clonal clustering tested on soluble+ barcode+ cells
clone_cells <- il7r_tab %>%
  filter(barcode != "none") %>%
  mutate(count_in  = IL7R_TM_in_CaRe  + IL7R_exon6_TM_in_BRIE,
         count_out = IL7R_TM_out_CaRe + IL7R_exon6_TM_out_BRIE) %>%
  group_by(barcode) %>%
  mutate(clone_size = n(), n_informative = sum((count_in + count_out) > 0)) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("\n=== Soluble+ cells available for a clonal test ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Barcoded cells: %d | isoform-informative: %d | soluble+: %d (Catch*ReSeq only: %d)\n",
            nrow(clone_cells), sum((clone_cells$count_in + clone_cells$count_out) > 0),
            sum(clone_cells$count_out > 0), sum(clone_cells$IL7R_TM_out_CaRe > 0)))
for (min_informative in c(2, 5, 10)) {
  keep <- clone_cells %>% filter(n_informative >= min_informative)
  cat(sprintf("  clones with >= %2d informative cells: %d clones | %d informative cells | %d soluble+\n",
              min_informative, n_distinct(keep$barcode),
              sum((keep$count_in + keep$count_out) > 0), sum(keep$count_out > 0)))
}

# --- Per-clone detection, Catch*ReSeq vs TenX ---
# In-text read-out only; this does not produce a panel.
min_clone_size <- 10
clone_method <- il7r_tab %>%
  filter(barcode != "none") %>%
  group_by(barcode) %>%
  summarise(clone_size = n(),
            care_prop = mean((IL7R_TM_in_CaRe + IL7R_TM_out_CaRe) > 0),
            brie_prop = mean((IL7R_exon6_TM_in_BRIE + IL7R_exon6_TM_out_BRIE) > 0),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(clone_size >= min_clone_size)

cat(sprintf("\n=== Per-clone detection: clones with >= %d cells (n = %d) ===\n",
            min_clone_size, nrow(clone_method)))
cat(sprintf("Catch*ReSeq detects in a larger fraction of the clone: %d | TenX larger: %d | tied: %d\n",
            sum(clone_method$care_prop > clone_method$brie_prop),
            sum(clone_method$brie_prop > clone_method$care_prop),
            sum(clone_method$care_prop == clone_method$brie_prop)))
cat(sprintf("Median clone fraction resolved: Catch*ReSeq %.3f vs TenX %.3f (paired Wilcoxon p = %.3g)\n",
            median(clone_method$care_prop), median(clone_method$brie_prop),
            wilcox.test(clone_method$care_prop, clone_method$brie_prop,
                        paired = TRUE)$p.value))
cat(sprintf("Clones with zero TenX detection: %d | clone-size-weighted Pearson r = %.3f\n",
            sum(clone_method$brie_prop == 0),
            cov.wt(clone_method[, c("care_prop", "brie_prop")],
                   wt = clone_method$clone_size, cor = TRUE)$cor[1, 2]))

# --- PTPRC composite isoform state ---
# Scores cassettes A and C jointly rather than one at a time, giving the in-text
# number behind a statement about PTPRC isoform state overall. Cassette B is
# excluded for the same reason as in Panel G, and a cell contributes only if it
# carries molecules informative for every cassette, so this runs on fewer cells
# than either cassette alone. Needs the Panel G chunk for `ptprc_umi`,
# `CASSETTES`, `MIN_CLONE_CELLS`, `N_HERITABILITY_PERM` and
# `permute_within_strata`.
set.seed(42)

# Per-cell psi for one cassette, from the molecules informative for it.
composite_psi <- function(exon) {
  d <- ptprc_umi %>%
    group_by(cellID, UMI) %>%
    summarise(inc = any(category == exon),
              exc = any(category == paste0(exon, "_exclusion")), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(inc | exc) %>%
    group_by(cellID) %>%
    summarise(n_umi = n(), psi = sum(inc) / n(), .groups = "drop")
  names(d) <- c("cellID", paste0("n_umi_", exon), paste0("psi_", exon))
  d
}

psi_wide <- Reduce(function(x, y) inner_join(x, y, by = "cellID"),
                   lapply(CASSETTES, composite_psi))

composite_cells <- psi_wide %>%
  inner_join(combined_gated %>% select(cellID, barcode, cluster), by = "cellID") %>%
  filter(barcode != "none") %>%
  group_by(barcode) %>% filter(n() >= MIN_CLONE_CELLS) %>% ungroup()

psi_matrix <- as.matrix(composite_cells[, paste0("psi_", CASSETTES)])

# Multivariate one-way partition of the joint psi vector. For Euclidean distance
# the distance-based (PERMANOVA) sums of squares equal the centroid form used
# here, which avoids rebuilding an N x N distance matrix on every permutation.
# Two statistics come out of the same partition:
#   r2  -- SS_between / SS_total, the PERMANOVA statistic. It is inflated by the
#          number of clones, so its permutation excess, not its raw value, is
#          the effect size, and it is NOT comparable to the ICC_MIN floor.
#   icc -- the mean-square form used by icc_one_way, which is comparable to the
#          per-cassette ICCs and to ICC_MIN.
permanova_partition <- function(values, groups) {
  groups     <- droplevels(factor(groups))
  n_total    <- nrow(values)
  n_groups   <- nlevels(groups)
  group_n    <- as.numeric(table(groups))
  grand_mean <- colMeans(values)
  centroids  <- t(vapply(split(seq_len(n_total), groups),
                         function(idx) colMeans(values[idx, , drop = FALSE]),
                         numeric(ncol(values))))
  ss_total   <- sum(sweep(values, 2, grand_mean)^2)
  ss_between <- sum(group_n * rowSums(sweep(centroids, 2, grand_mean)^2))
  ss_within  <- ss_total - ss_between
  ms_between <- ss_between / (n_groups - 1)
  ms_within  <- ss_within  / (n_total - n_groups)
  n0 <- (n_total - sum(group_n^2) / n_total) / (n_groups - 1)
  c(r2  = ss_between / ss_total,
    icc = (ms_between - ms_within) / (ms_between + (n0 - 1) * ms_within))
}

observed_composite <- permanova_partition(psi_matrix, composite_cells$barcode)

composite_nulls <- list(
  "global"          = function() sample(composite_cells$barcode),
  "cluster-matched" = function() permute_within_strata(composite_cells$barcode,
                                                       composite_cells$cluster))
composite_draws <- lapply(composite_nulls, function(permute)
  replicate(N_HERITABILITY_PERM, permanova_partition(psi_matrix, permute())))

cat(sprintf("composite (%s): %d cells | %d clones\n",
            paste(names(CASSETTES), collapse = "+"),
            nrow(composite_cells), n_distinct(composite_cells$barcode)))
# Coverage cost of requiring every cassette in the same cell.
for (cassette in names(CASSETTES))
  cat(sprintf("  cassette %s alone: %d cells with informative molecules\n",
              cassette, nrow(composite_psi(CASSETTES[[cassette]]))))

for (stat in c("r2", "icc")) {
  p <- vapply(composite_draws, function(x)
    (sum(x[stat, ] >= observed_composite[[stat]]) + 1) / (N_HERITABILITY_PERM + 1),
    numeric(1))
  excess <- vapply(composite_draws,
                   function(x) observed_composite[[stat]] - median(x[stat, ]),
                   numeric(1))
  cat(sprintf("  %-3s observed %.4f | %s\n", stat, observed_composite[[stat]],
              paste(sprintf("%s p = %.4g (excess over null median %+.4f)",
                            names(p), p, excess), collapse = " | ")))
}
```

### min_reads threshold for the host isoform calls

Prerequisite: bamsort stepTwo `*_UMI_read_counts_full.csv` for the host targets
and the integrated CSV (for the valid cellID list). Sweeps `min_reads` over the
per-molecule read counts and prints, for each cassette, the exclusion fraction
and the fraction of molecules kept, plus the PTPRC constant-exon exclusion rate,
which is the internal false-exclusion floor. Backs the choice of `min_reads = 2`
in the host CaRe extraction chunk.

```{r}
processed.dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/CaRe/stepTwo/processed/")
valid_cells   <- integrated$cellID
min_reads_sweep <- c(1, 2, 3, 5, 10)

# A constant exon cannot be spliced out, so any exclusion call on PTPRC_constant
# is a false positive. Its rate at each threshold is the artifact floor that
# min_reads has to suppress, measured without reference to BRIE2.
cassettes <- list(
  c("IL7R",  "IL7R_exon6_TM",  "IL7R_exon6_TM_exclusion"),
  c("PTPRC", "PTPRC_exon4",    "PTPRC_exon4_exclusion"),
  c("PTPRC", "PTPRC_exon6",    "PTPRC_exon6_exclusion"),
  c("PTPRC", "PTPRC_constant", "PTPRC_constant_exclusion")
)

for (cassette in cassettes) {
  gene <- cassette[1]; inclusion <- cassette[2]; exclusion <- cassette[3]
  umis <- read.csv(paste0(processed.dir, gene, "_UMI_read_counts_full.csv")) %>%
    filter(cellID %in% valid_cells, category %in% c(inclusion, exclusion))
  cat(sprintf("\n=== %s vs %s ===\n", inclusion, exclusion))
  for (min_reads in min_reads_sweep) {
    kept <- umis %>% filter(read_count >= min_reads)
    n_inclusion <- sum(kept$category == inclusion)
    n_exclusion <- sum(kept$category == exclusion)
    cat(sprintf("  min_reads >= %2d: inclusion = %6d | exclusion = %5d | exclusion fraction = %6.2f%% | molecules kept = %3.0f%%\n",
                min_reads, n_inclusion, n_exclusion,
                100 * n_exclusion / (n_inclusion + n_exclusion),
                100 * nrow(kept) / nrow(umis)))
  }
}

# read_count is per (cellID, UMI, category), so a molecule whose reads split
# across two categories is thresholded on each part rather than on its total.
il7r_umis <- read.csv(paste0(processed.dir, "IL7R_UMI_read_counts_full.csv")) %>%
  filter(cellID %in% valid_cells)
molecules <- il7r_umis %>%
  group_by(cellID, UMI) %>%
  summarise(n_categories = n(), reads_total = sum(read_count), .groups = "drop")
split_exclusion <- il7r_umis %>%
  filter(category == "IL7R_exon6_TM_exclusion", read_count == 1) %>%
  left_join(molecules, by = c("cellID", "UMI"))
cat(sprintf("\nIL7R molecules split across categories: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            sum(molecules$n_categories > 1), nrow(molecules),
            100 * mean(molecules$n_categories > 1)))
cat(sprintf("Single-read exclusion rows whose molecule carries >= 2 reads overall: %d / %d\n",
            sum(split_exclusion$reads_total >= 2), nrow(split_exclusion)))
```

# Liver

## Extraction

### Raw cellIDs from 10X

Prerequisite: 10X CellRanger outputs under `singleCell/counts/GRCm39_*/outs/raw_feature_bc_matrix/`.

```{r raw_cellIDs}
raw_out_dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/liver/singleCell/raw_cellIDs")
dir.create(raw_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

samples <- data.frame(
  datasets = c("Esrp2KO_sham24_R1", "Normal_SHAM24_R2"),
  samples  = c("Esrp2KO",           "Normal")
)

raw_cellIDs <- list()
all_cellIDs <- data.frame(cellID = character(), sample = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(samples))) {
  dataset_name <- samples$datasets[i]
  sample_name  <- samples$samples[i]
  folder <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/liver/singleCell/counts/")
  rawDataFolder <- paste0(folder, "GRCm39_", dataset_name, "/outs/raw_feature_bc_matrix/")

  tryCatch({
    rawdata <- Read10X(rawDataFolder)
    umi_counts <- colSums(rawdata)
    cell_ids <- names(umi_counts[umi_counts > 100])
    raw_cellIDs[[sample_name]] <- cell_ids

    all_cellIDs <- rbind(all_cellIDs,
                         data.frame(cellID = cell_ids, sample = sample_name,
                                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    write.csv(data.frame(cellID = cell_ids),
              file.path(raw_out_dir, paste0(sample_name, "_raw_cellIDs.csv")),
              row.names = FALSE)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error processing", dataset_name, ":", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
  })
  if (exists("rawdata")) { rm(rawdata); gc() }
}

write.csv(all_cellIDs, file.path(raw_out_dir, "all_raw_cellIDs.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

### Seurat integration

Prerequisite: the liver cellranger outputs under
`singleCell/counts/GRCm39_{Esrp2KO_sham24_R1,Normal_SHAM24_R2}/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/`.

```{r}
output.dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/liver/singleCell/Seurat/integrated/")
umap.dir   <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/liver/singleCell/Seurat/UMAPcoords/")
dir.create(output.dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(umap.dir,   recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

load_packages("seurat_extra")   # scCustomize, for Add_Mito_Ribo

INTEGRATION_SEED <- 42

samples <- data.frame(
  datasets = c("Esrp2KO_sham24_R1", "Normal_SHAM24_R2"),
  samples  = c("Esrp2KO",           "Normal")
)

integrated_rds <- paste0(output.dir, "integrated.rds")

if (file.exists(integrated_rds)) {
  integrated <- readRDS(integrated_rds)
} else {
  sample_objects <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(samples))) {
    sample_name <- samples$samples[i]
    input.dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/liver/singleCell/counts/GRCm39_",
                        samples$datasets[i], "/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/")

    sample_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = Read10X(data.dir = input.dir),
                                     project = sample_name,
                                     min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
    sample_obj <- Add_Mito_Ribo(sample_obj, species = "mouse")
    sample_obj <- subset(sample_obj,
                         subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 3500 &
                                  nCount_RNA < 20000 & percent_mito < 5)
    # Barcodes are prefixed here, which is what makes cellID join across the
    # Ca*Re tables, the UMAP coords and the joint CSV.
    sample_objects[[sample_name]] <- RenameCells(sample_obj,
                                                 add.cell.id = sample_name)
  }

  integrated <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y), sample_objects)

  set.seed(INTEGRATION_SEED)
  integrated <- SCTransform(integrated, vst.flavor = "v2",
                            seed.use = INTEGRATION_SEED)
  integrated <- RunPCA(integrated, verbose = FALSE,
                       seed.use = INTEGRATION_SEED)
  # HarmonyIntegration takes no seed argument, so the session seed is what
  # fixes its k-means initialisation.
  set.seed(INTEGRATION_SEED)
  integrated <- IntegrateLayers(integrated, method = HarmonyIntegration,
                                orig.reduction = "pca",
                                new.reduction = "harmony",
                                normalization.method = "SCT",
                                verbose = FALSE)

  integrated <- FindNeighbors(integrated, reduction = "harmony",
                              dims = 1:REDUCTION_DIMENSIONS)
  integrated <- FindClusters(integrated, resolution = 0.7, algorithm = 4,
                             random.seed = INTEGRATION_SEED)
  integrated <- RunUMAP(integrated, dims = 1:REDUCTION_DIMENSIONS,
                        reduction = "harmony", seed.use = INTEGRATION_SEED)

  saveRDS(integrated, integrated_rds)
}

ggsave(paste0(output.dir, "integrated_umap.pdf"),
       DimPlot(integrated, reduction = "umap"))
ggsave(paste0(output.dir, "integrated_umap_orig.ident.pdf"),
       DimPlot(integrated, reduction = "umap", split.by = "orig.ident"))

# Cell-level table the Joining chunk reads. row.names are kept because that
# chunk reads this file with row.names = "X".
integrated[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(integrated[["RNA"]])
umap_coords <- Embeddings(integrated, reduction = "umap")
integrated_umap <- data.frame(
  cellID  = colnames(integrated),
  UMAP1   = umap_coords[, 1],
  UMAP2   = umap_coords[, 2],
  cluster = Idents(integrated),
  size    = colSums(GetAssayData(integrated, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")),
  sample  = ifelse(integrated$orig.ident == "Normal", "WT", "KO")
)
write.csv(integrated_umap, paste0(umap.dir, "integrated_UMAP_coords.csv"))
```


### Ca*Re bamsort + minimums

Prerequisite: `extractionScripts/submissionScripts/Figure4/liver_stepTwo_bamsort.sh`
then `liver_stepThree_process.sh`, run on the Ca*Re BAMs.

```{r}
input_dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/liver/CaRe/stepTwo/processed/")
samples_df <- c("KO_Dgkd", "KO_Kras", "KO_Lsm14b", "KO_Nf2", "KO_Slkv4",
               "WT_Dgkd", "WT_Kras", "WT_Lsm14b", "WT_Nf2", "WT_Slkv4")

# min_umi is a coverage gate: a cell is admitted on 2 molecules that report on
# the cassette exon, whichever isoform they carry. Nf2 and Slk probes sit in a
# flanking constant exon, so those two also yield `<target>_exclusion` molecules
# and either isoform can fill the quota; Kras, Lsm14b and Dgkd probes sit inside
# the cassette exon, so their exclusion count is structurally zero and the quota
# can only be filled by inclusion. Panel L reads the admitted set, not an
# inclusion call, which is what keeps the two cases comparable.
process_all_set_minimums("host", samples_df, input_dir,
                           TRUE, output_dir = paste0(input_dir, "minimum/"),
                           min_reads = 2, min_umi = 2)

```

### Joining

Prerequisite: Seurat integration finished and `integrated_UMAP_coords.csv` written.

```{r}
groups <- c("KO" = "Esrp2KO", "WT" = "Normal")
targets <- c("Dgkd", "Kras", "Lsm14b", "Nf2", "Slkv4")

CaRe.dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/liver/CaRe/stepTwo/processed/")
umap.dir  <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/liver/singleCell/Seurat/UMAPcoords/")

umap_file <- paste0(umap.dir, "integrated_UMAP_coords.csv")
umap_data <- read.csv(umap_file, row.names = "X")
all_cells <- unique(as.character(umap_data$cellID))
result <- data.frame(cellID = all_cells) %>%
  left_join(umap_data %>% select(-any_of("V2"), -sample), by = "cellID")

care_combined <- data.frame()

for (i in seq_along(groups)) {
  group_name <- names(groups)[i]
  prefix     <- paste0(groups[i], "_")

  care_files <- paste0(CaRe.dir, "minimum/", group_name, "_", targets, "_host_filtered.csv")
  care_files <- care_files[file.exists(care_files)]
  care_list  <- lapply(care_files, function(f) {
    sdf <- read.csv(f); sdf$total <- NULL; sdf
  })
  care_data <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = "cellID", all = TRUE), care_list)
  care_data[is.na(care_data)] <- 0
  care_data$cellID <- paste0(prefix, care_data$cellID)

  care_combined <- bind_rows(care_combined, care_data)
}

# TenX values come from the integrated Seurat counts matrix
seurat_obj <- readRDS(paste0(data.root, "Figure4/liver/singleCell/Seurat/integrated/integrated.rds"))
rna_assay  <- JoinLayers(seurat_obj[["RNA"]])
counts_mat <- GetAssayData(rna_assay, layer = "counts")

targets <- c("Kras", "Nf2", "Slk", "Lsm14b", "Dgkd")
present_targets <- intersect(targets, rownames(counts_mat))
seurat_tenx <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(counts_mat[present_targets, , drop = FALSE])))
seurat_tenx$cellID <- rownames(seurat_tenx)
tenx_processed <- seurat_tenx %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_TenX"), -cellID)
result <- left_join(result, tenx_processed, by = "cellID")

care_processed <- care_combined %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_CaRe"), -cellID)
result <- left_join(result, care_processed, by = "cellID")

result[is.na(result)] <- 0
# Zero-out CaRe calls in cells where Seurat does not detect the gene.
# Targets with skipping reads carry a `<gene>_exclusion` column
tenx_col_for <- function(care_col) {
  paste0(sub("(_exclusion)?_CaRe$", "", care_col), "_TenX")
}
result <- result %>%
  mutate(across(ends_with("_CaRe"), ~ ifelse(
    pick(everything())[[tenx_col_for(cur_column())]] == 0, 0, .x
  )))
```

### BRIE2 join and CSV save

Prerequisite: BRIE2 run per cell, written to `BRIE2/brie2_per_cell_target_exons.csv`
by `extractionScripts/submissionScripts/Figure4/brie2.sh liver_WT liver_KO`.

```{r}
brie <- read.csv(paste0(data.root, "Figure4/liver/singleCell/BRIE2/brie2_per_cell_target_exons.csv")) %>%
  mutate(cellID = paste0(ifelse(sample == "WT", "Normal", "Esrp2KO"), "_", cell_barcode))

brie_wide <- brie %>%
  mutate(target = sub("_.*", "", gene)) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = cellID,
    names_from = target,
    values_from = c(isoform1, isoform2, psi),
    names_sep = "_"
  ) %>%
  rename_with(~ sub("^isoform1_", "", .) %>% paste0("_in_BRIE"),  starts_with("isoform1_")) %>%
  rename_with(~ sub("^isoform2_", "", .) %>% paste0("_out_BRIE"), starts_with("isoform2_")) %>%
  rename_with(~ sub("^psi_",      "", .) %>% paste0("_psi_BRIE"), starts_with("psi_"))
brie_wide[is.na(brie_wide)] <- 0

joint_data <- left_join(result, brie_wide, by = "cellID")

save_dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/liver/joint/integrated/")
dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(joint_data, paste0(save_dir, "integrated_all_with_BRIE.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

### Panel L

Prerequisites: BRIE2 on TenX, via
`extractionScripts/submissionScripts/Figure4/brie2.sh`.

Exon-targeting (Kras, Lsm14b, Dgkd) scored on inclusion.
Splice-targeting (Nf2 and Slk) scored on inclusion + exclusion.

Not restricted to hepatocytes. Supp Fig 4H-J do restrict to hepatocytes

```{r}
exon_labels  <- c(Kras = "exon 5", Nf2 = "exon 15", Slk = "exon 13",
                  Lsm14b = "exon 5", Dgkd = "exon 29")
target_order <- c("Kras", "Nf2", "Slk", "Lsm14b", "Dgkd")

# splice- vs exon-targeting
care_informative <- function(d, gene_name) {
  pos <- d[[paste0(gene_name, "_CaRe")]] > 0
  exc_col <- paste0(gene_name, "_exclusion_CaRe")
  if (exc_col %in% names(d)) pos <- pos | d[[exc_col]] > 0
  pos
}
tenx_informative <- function(d, gene_name) {
  # Match the TenX arm to the Ca*Re strategy
  x <- d[[paste0(gene_name, "_in_BRIE")]]
  if (paste0(gene_name, "_exclusion_CaRe") %in% names(d)) {
    x <- x + d[[paste0(gene_name, "_out_BRIE")]]
  }
  x > 0
}

# Per-gene Ca*Re vs BRIE2(TenX) informative fraction in <gene>_TenX+ cells, per
# genotype, with Clopper-Pearson CIs and a paired McNemar Ca*Re-vs-TenX p-value.
compute_panel_data <- function(gene_name) {
  tenx_col <- paste0(gene_name, "_TenX")

  sc_frac <- df %>%
    filter(.data[[tenx_col]] > 0) %>%
    mutate(care_pos = care_informative(pick(everything()), gene_name),
           brie_pos = tenx_informative(pick(everything()), gene_name)) %>%
    group_by(genotype) %>%
    summarise(total = n(),
              `Ca*Re` = sum(care_pos),
              TenX    = sum(brie_pos),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    rename(condition = genotype) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(`Ca*Re`, TenX),
                 names_to = "method", values_to = "n_detected") %>%
    mutate(value = n_detected / total) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(ci = list(binom.test(n_detected, total)$conf.int),
           ci_lower = ci[1], ci_upper = ci[2]) %>%
    ungroup() %>% select(-ci) %>%
    mutate(method    = factor(method, levels = c("TenX", "Ca*Re")),
           condition = factor(condition, levels = c("WT", "KO")))

  mcnemar_care_vs_tenx <- function(condition_name) {
    cells <- df %>% filter(.data[[tenx_col]] > 0, genotype == condition_name)
    if (nrow(cells) < 2) return(NA_real_)
    tbl <- table(factor(care_informative(cells, gene_name), c(FALSE, TRUE)),
                 factor(tenx_informative(cells, gene_name), c(FALSE, TRUE)))
    tryCatch(mcnemar.test(tbl)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  }
  sig_data <- sc_frac %>% distinct(condition) %>% rowwise() %>%
    mutate(p_value = mcnemar_care_vs_tenx(as.character(condition)),
           sig = case_when(is.na(p_value)  ~ "n.s.",
                           p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
                           p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
                           p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
                           TRUE            ~ "n.s.")) %>% ungroup()

  list(gene_name = gene_name, combined = sc_frac, sig_data = sig_data)
}

panel_data <- lapply(target_order, compute_panel_data)
names(panel_data) <- target_order

wt_detection <- bind_rows(lapply(target_order, function(g) {
  d    <- panel_data[[g]]$combined %>% filter(condition == "WT")
  care <- d %>% filter(method == "Ca*Re")
  tenx  <- d %>% filter(method == "TenX")
  data.frame(gene      = g,
             total     = care$total,
             care_n    = care$n_detected, care_frac = care$value,
             tenx_n     = tenx$n_detected,  tenx_frac  = tenx$value,
             fold      = care$value / tenx$value,
             mcnemar_p = panel_data[[g]]$sig_data %>%
                         filter(condition == "WT") %>% pull(p_value))
}))
cat("WT Ca*Re vs TenX detection across all target genes:\n")
print(wt_detection)
wt_significant <- wt_detection %>% filter(!is.na(mcnemar_p), mcnemar_p < 0.05)
cat(sprintf(paste0("In %d of %d targets (%s), Ca*Re recovered a molecule informative ",
                   "for the Esrp2 target exon in %.1f%%-%.1f%% of TenX+ WT cells ",
                   "vs %.1f%%-%.1f%% by TenX (McNemar p = %.2g-%.2g)\n"),
            nrow(wt_significant), nrow(wt_detection),
            paste(wt_significant$gene, collapse = ", "),
            100 * min(wt_significant$care_frac), 100 * max(wt_significant$care_frac),
            100 * min(wt_significant$tenx_frac),  100 * max(wt_significant$tenx_frac),
            min(wt_significant$mcnemar_p), max(wt_significant$mcnemar_p)))


method_colors <- c("Ca*Re" = "#00AEEF", "TenX" = "#2B3990")
method_labels <- c(
  "TenX"  = "<span style='color:#2B3990'>**TenX**</span>",
  "Ca*Re" = "<span style='color:#00AEEF'>**Ca&#42;Re**</span>")

panel_one_genotype <- function(pd, target_genotype, y_global, y_ceiling,
                               show_axis = FALSE) {
  combined    <- pd$combined %>% filter(condition == target_genotype)
  brackets_df <- pd$sig_data %>% filter(condition == target_genotype) %>%
    mutate(x_left = 1, x_right = 2,
           y_bracket = y_global * 1.15,
           y_tick    = y_global * 0.03,
           y_label   = y_bracket + y_global * 0.04)

  ggplot(combined, aes(x = method, y = value, fill = method)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.62) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper),
                  width = 0.18, linewidth = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_segment(data = brackets_df, inherit.aes = FALSE,
                 aes(x = x_left, xend = x_right, y = y_bracket, yend = y_bracket),
                 linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_segment(data = brackets_df, inherit.aes = FALSE,
                 aes(x = x_left, xend = x_left, y = y_bracket - y_tick, yend = y_bracket),
                 linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_segment(data = brackets_df, inherit.aes = FALSE,
                 aes(x = x_right, xend = x_right, y = y_bracket - y_tick, yend = y_bracket),
                 linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text(data = brackets_df, inherit.aes = FALSE,
              aes(x = (x_left + x_right) / 2, y = y_label, label = sig), size = 4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = method_colors) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = method_labels) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, y_ceiling),
                       breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(5),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
    labs(x = NULL,
         y = if (show_axis) "P(exon recovery | gene+)" else NULL,
         title = sprintf("***%s***<br>%s", pd$gene_name, exon_labels[[pd$gene_name]]),
         fill = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.title   = ggtext::element_markdown(hjust = 0.5, size = 13,
                                                  lineheight = 1.2),
          axis.text.x  = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 11),
          axis.text.y  = if (show_axis) element_text(size = 11) else element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y = if (show_axis) element_line() else element_blank(),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
          plot.margin  = margin(4, 5, 2, 2))
}

target_genotype <- "WT"
y_global <- max(unlist(lapply(panel_data, function(pd) {
  d <- pd$combined %>% filter(condition == target_genotype)
  c(d$value, d$ci_upper)
})), na.rm = TRUE)
y_ceiling <- y_global * 1.25

panel_plots <- Map(function(pd, first) {
  panel_one_genotype(pd, target_genotype, y_global, y_ceiling, show_axis = first)
}, panel_data, seq_along(panel_data) == 1)
panel_combo <- wrap_plots(panel_plots, nrow = 1)

ggsave(paste0(output.dir, "PanelL_alltargets_WT_barplot.pdf"),
       panel_combo, width = 10, height = 3.6)
print(panel_combo)
```

```{r}
df_umap <- df %>% mutate(Kras_CaRe_log = log1p(Kras_CaRe))
color_limits <- c(0, max(df_umap$Kras_CaRe_log, na.rm = TRUE))

plot_umap_single <- function(data, title, color_limits, color = "#00AEEF") {
  data <- data[order(data$Kras_CaRe_log), ]
  data$size_flag <- ifelse(data$Kras_CaRe_log > 0, "nonzero", "zero")

  ggplot(data, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Kras_CaRe_log, size = size_flag), shape = 16) +
    scale_size_manual(values = c("zero" = 0.5, "nonzero" = 1.5)) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "gray93", high = color, limits = color_limits) +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.title = element_text(size = rel(0.6)),
          legend.text = element_text(size = rel(0.6), angle = 30),
          axis.text = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = element_blank()) +
    labs(title = title, color = "") +
    guides(size = "none")
}
```

### Cluster 5 characterization

Four quick takes to support the "cluster 5 is enriched for Kras exon
inclusion after controlling for Kras expression" claim from Supp Fig 4J:

1. **Top markers** of cluster 5 vs all other hepatocyte clusters (Wilcoxon,
   only positive, |log2FC| > 0.5, p_adj < 0.05).
2. **Liver zonation context** — row-z-scored mean log-norm expression of
   canonical pericentral / midlobular / periportal markers across the six
   hepatocyte clusters, to place cluster 5 in lobular geography.
3. **WT/KO composition** of each hepatocyte cluster, to confirm cluster 5
   isn't a genotype-skewed artifact.
4. **Fetal-like / proliferative / Hippo-YAP markers** — Esrp2 KO has been
   reported to reactivate a fetal program; this heatmap asks whether cluster
   5 carries the fetal/proliferative signature that would explain residual
   Esrp2-target inclusion despite the KO.

Prerequisites: the liver `## Extraction` chunks above.

```{r}
hepatocyte_clusters <- c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6")
df <- read.csv(paste0(data.root, "Figure4/liver/joint/integrated/integrated_all_with_BRIE.csv")) %>%
  mutate(genotype = factor(ifelse(grepl("^Normal_", cellID), "WT", "KO"),
                           levels = c("WT", "KO")))

seurat_obj <- readRDS(paste0(data.root, "Figure4/liver/singleCell/Seurat/integrated/integrated.rds"))
seurat_obj[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(seurat_obj[["RNA"]])
seurat_obj <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj, assay = "RNA", verbose = FALSE)
DefaultAssay(seurat_obj) <- "RNA"

seurat_cells   <- colnames(seurat_obj)
cluster_lookup <- df %>%
  mutate(seurat_cellID = ifelse(cellID %in% seurat_cells,
                                cellID,
                                sub("^(Normal|Esrp2KO)_", "", cellID))) %>%
  filter(seurat_cellID %in% seurat_cells) %>%
  select(seurat_cellID, cluster) %>%
  mutate(cluster = as.character(cluster)) %>%
  tibble::deframe()
seurat_obj$df_cluster <- cluster_lookup[seurat_cells]
Idents(seurat_obj) <- "df_cluster"

# 1. Marker genes: cluster 5 vs other hepatocyte clusters --------------------
c5_markers <- FindMarkers(seurat_obj,
                          ident.1 = "5",
                          ident.2 = setdiff(hepatocyte_clusters, "5"),
                          only.pos = TRUE,
                          logfc.threshold = 0.5,
                          min.pct = 0.25,
                          verbose = FALSE) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  arrange(p_val_adj) %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05)

cat("\n=== Top 20 cluster 5 markers (vs hepatocyte clusters ",
    paste(setdiff(hepatocyte_clusters, "5"), collapse = ", "), ") ===\n",
    sep = "")
print(head(c5_markers, 20))

# 2. Liver zonation marker expression ----------------------------------------
zonation_markers <- list(
  pericentral = c("Glul", "Cyp2e1", "Oat", "Cyp1a2", "Axin2"),
  midlobular  = c("Cyp2f2", "Hal"),
  periportal  = c("Sds", "G6pc", "Cps1", "Aldh1b1", "Asl", "Hnf4a")
)
zone_genes <- stack(zonation_markers) %>%
  rename(gene = values, zone = ind) %>%
  mutate(gene = as.character(gene),
         zone = factor(zone, levels = c("pericentral", "midlobular", "periportal")))
zone_genes <- zone_genes %>% filter(gene %in% rownames(seurat_obj))

hep_cells_mask <- !is.na(seurat_obj$df_cluster) &
                  seurat_obj$df_cluster %in% hepatocyte_clusters
hep_cells      <- seurat_cells[hep_cells_mask]
hep_clusters   <- seurat_obj$df_cluster[hep_cells]
expr_mat <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")[
  zone_genes$gene, hep_cells, drop = FALSE]

zone_mean <- t(sapply(zone_genes$gene, function(g) {
  tapply(expr_mat[g, ], hep_clusters, mean)
}, simplify = TRUE))
zone_mean <- zone_mean[, hepatocyte_clusters, drop = FALSE]
zone_z    <- t(scale(t(zone_mean)))

zone_long <- as.data.frame(zone_z) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "cluster", values_to = "z") %>%
  left_join(zone_genes, by = "gene") %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = factor(cluster, levels = hepatocyte_clusters),
    gene    = factor(gene,    levels = zone_genes$gene)
  )

zone_heat <- ggplot(zone_long, aes(x = cluster, y = gene, fill = z)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  facet_grid(zone ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(name = "Z-score\n(row)",
                       low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
                       midpoint = 0) +
  labs(x = "Hepatocyte cluster", y = NULL,
       title = "Liver zonation marker expression (z-scored across clusters)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold"),
        strip.placement   = "outside",
        panel.grid        = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y       = element_text(face = "italic"))

print(zone_heat)

# 3. WT/KO composition per hepatocyte cluster --------------------------------
composition <- df %>%
  filter(as.character(cluster) %in% hepatocyte_clusters) %>%
  mutate(cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = hepatocyte_clusters)) %>%
  group_by(cluster, genotype) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  mutate(frac          = n / sum(n),
         cluster_total = sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

cluster_totals <- composition %>% distinct(cluster, cluster_total)

cat("\n=== WT/KO composition per hepatocyte cluster ===\n")
print(composition)

comp_plot <- ggplot(composition, aes(x = cluster, y = frac, fill = genotype)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 3, color = "white", fontface = "bold") +
  geom_text(data = cluster_totals, inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(x = cluster, y = 1.04, label = paste0("n=", cluster_total)),
            size = 2.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("WT" = "#C49A6C", "KO" = "#603913")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
  labs(x = "Hepatocyte cluster", y = "Fraction of cells", fill = NULL,
       title = "WT/KO composition per hepatocyte cluster") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)

print(comp_plot)

# 4. Fetal / proliferative / Hippo-YAP markers per cluster -------------------

state_markers <- list(
  `Fetal/progenitor`           = c("Afp", "Dlk1", "Epcam", "Anpep",
                                    "Fxyd1", "Gjb1"),
  `ESRP2 splice targets (TenX)` = c("Csnk1d", "Nf2", "Slk", "Arhgef10l",
                                    "Flnb", "Kras"),
  `YAP/TAZ targets`            = c("Areg", "Ptgs2", "Birc5", "Fgf1", "Itgb2")
)
state_genes_df <- stack(state_markers) %>%
  rename(gene = values, category = ind) %>%
  mutate(gene = as.character(gene)) %>%
  filter(gene %in% rownames(seurat_obj))

cat("\n=== Cluster-5 fetal / proliferative / YAP markers ===\n")
cat("Detected (of requested):", nrow(state_genes_df), "of",
    length(unlist(state_markers)), "\n")
missing_genes <- setdiff(unlist(state_markers), state_genes_df$gene)
if (length(missing_genes) > 0) {
  cat("Missing from RNA assay:", paste(missing_genes, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

state_expr <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")[
  state_genes_df$gene, hep_cells, drop = FALSE]
state_mean <- t(sapply(state_genes_df$gene, function(g) {
  tapply(state_expr[g, ], hep_clusters, mean)
}, simplify = TRUE))
state_mean <- state_mean[, hepatocyte_clusters, drop = FALSE]
state_z    <- t(scale(t(state_mean)))

state_long <- as.data.frame(state_z) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "cluster", values_to = "z") %>%
  left_join(state_genes_df, by = "gene") %>%
  mutate(
    cluster  = factor(cluster, levels = hepatocyte_clusters),
    category = factor(category, levels = names(state_markers)),
    gene     = factor(gene, levels = state_genes_df$gene)
  )

state_heat <- ggplot(state_long, aes(x = cluster, y = gene, fill = z)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  facet_grid(category ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(name = "Z-score\n(row)",
                       low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
                       midpoint = 0) +
  labs(x = "Hepatocyte cluster", y = NULL,
       title = "Fetal / proliferative / YAP-TAZ markers (z-scored across clusters)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold"),
        strip.placement   = "outside",
        panel.grid        = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y       = element_text(face = "italic"))

print(state_heat)
```

### Esrp2 knockout at the transcript level

Prerequisites: the liver `df` above and
`Figure4/liver/singleCell/Seurat/integrated/integrated.rds`.

Supports "We confirmed Esrp2 expression knockout in these cells". Hepatocytes
only (clusters 1-6), taken from `df` so the restriction does not depend on the
cluster numbering of the object that happens to be on disk. Both the UMI totals
and the per-cell detection counts are printed: Fisher's exact is a test of the
cell-detection table, so that is the pair of numbers its p-value belongs to.

```{r}
seurat_obj <- readRDS(paste0(data.root,
  "Figure4/liver/singleCell/Seurat/integrated/integrated.rds"))
seurat_obj[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(seurat_obj[["RNA"]])
seurat_obj <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj, assay = "RNA", verbose = FALSE)

esrp2_umis <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")["Esrp2", ]

hepatocytes <- df %>%
  mutate(seurat_cellID = ifelse(cellID %in% colnames(seurat_obj), cellID,
                                sub("^(Normal|Esrp2KO)_", "", cellID))) %>%
  filter(seurat_cellID %in% colnames(seurat_obj),
         as.character(cluster) %in% hepatocyte_clusters) %>%
  mutate(esrp2_umis = esrp2_umis[seurat_cellID],
         esrp2_pos  = esrp2_umis > 0)

knockout_summary <- hepatocytes %>% group_by(genotype) %>%
  summarise(n_cells = n(), n_esrp2_pos = sum(esrp2_pos),
            total_esrp2_umis = sum(esrp2_umis),
            pct_esrp2_pos = 100 * mean(esrp2_pos), .groups = "drop")
print(as.data.frame(knockout_summary), row.names = FALSE)

knockout_fisher <- fisher.test(
  table(factor(hepatocytes$genotype, c("WT", "KO")),
        factor(hepatocytes$esrp2_pos, c(FALSE, TRUE))))

knockout_values <- function(target_genotype, column) {
  knockout_summary[[column]][knockout_summary$genotype == target_genotype]
}
cat(sprintf(paste0("\nWe confirmed Esrp2 expression knockout in these cells ",
                   "(%d / %s knockout hepatocytes versus %d / %s wildtype ",
                   "hepatocytes; Fisher's exact p = %.3g).\n"),
            knockout_values("KO", "n_esrp2_pos"),
            format(knockout_values("KO", "n_cells"), big.mark = ","),
            knockout_values("WT", "n_esrp2_pos"),
            format(knockout_values("WT", "n_cells"), big.mark = ","),
            knockout_fisher$p.value))
cat(sprintf("Esrp2 UMIs behind those cells: %d (KO) and %d (WT).\n",
            knockout_values("KO", "total_esrp2_umis"),
            knockout_values("WT", "total_esrp2_umis")))

# A knockout call rests on the absence being specific, so the one residual KO
# cell is printed with its UMI count rather than summarised away.
residual_knockout <- hepatocytes %>% filter(genotype == "KO", esrp2_umis > 0)
if (nrow(residual_knockout) > 0) {
  print(residual_knockout %>% select(cellID, cluster, esrp2_umis) %>%
          as.data.frame(), row.names = FALSE)
}
cat(sprintf("KO cluster 5: %d cells, %d Esrp2 UMIs.\n",
            sum(hepatocytes$genotype == "KO" & hepatocytes$cluster == 5),
            sum(hepatocytes$esrp2_umis[hepatocytes$genotype == "KO" &
                                       hepatocytes$cluster == 5])))
```

### Esrp2 level in cells with and without a detected exon

Prerequisites: the chunk above, for `hepatocytes` and the normalized
`seurat_obj`.

Supports "Esrp2 expression did not differ between cells with and without
Catch\*ReSeq-detected alternatively spliced exons". WT only, since Esrp2 is not
detected in the knockout.

One row per (cell, target) the cell expresses, rather than one row per cell:
pooling on "Ca\*Re+ for any target" would give a cell expressing three targets
three chances of a call and a cell expressing one only one, which enriches the
Ca\*Re+ group for multi-target and deeper cells.

```{r}
POOLED_TARGETS <- c("Kras", "Nf2", "Slk")

esrp2_lognorm <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")["Esrp2", ]

target_rows <- bind_rows(lapply(POOLED_TARGETS, function(target) {
  hepatocytes %>%
    filter(genotype == "WT", .data[[paste0(target, "_TenX")]] > 0) %>%
    transmute(cellID, target,
              care_pos  = .data[[paste0(target, "_CaRe")]] > 0,
              esrp2     = esrp2_lognorm[seurat_cellID],
              esrp2_pos = esrp2 > 0,
              nCount    = seurat_obj$nCount_RNA[seurat_cellID])
}))

row_summary <- target_rows %>% group_by(care_pos) %>%
  summarise(rows = n(), n_esrp2_pos = sum(esrp2_pos),
            pct_esrp2_pos = 100 * mean(esrp2_pos), .groups = "drop")
print(as.data.frame(row_summary), row.names = FALSE)

esrp2_fisher <- fisher.test(table(factor(target_rows$care_pos, c(FALSE, TRUE)),
                                  factor(target_rows$esrp2_pos, c(FALSE, TRUE))))

row_values <- function(status, column) row_summary[[column]][row_summary$care_pos == status]
cat(sprintf(paste0("\nEsrp2 expression did not differ between cells with and ",
                   "without Catch*ReSeq-detected alternatively spliced exons ",
                   "(%d / %d (%.1f%%) versus %d / %d (%.1f%%); Fisher's exact ",
                   "p = %.2g).\n"),
            row_values(TRUE, "n_esrp2_pos"), row_values(TRUE, "rows"),
            row_values(TRUE, "pct_esrp2_pos"),
            row_values(FALSE, "n_esrp2_pos"), row_values(FALSE, "rows"),
            row_values(FALSE, "pct_esrp2_pos"), esrp2_fisher$p.value))

# Esrp2 detection tracks library size, so the claim is also given adjusted for
# depth and for which target a row belongs to.
cat(sprintf("Wilcoxon on log-normalized Esrp2: p = %.2g\n",
            wilcox.test(esrp2 ~ care_pos, data = target_rows)$p.value))
print(summary(glm(esrp2_pos ~ care_pos + target + log1p(nCount),
                  data = target_rows, family = binomial))$coefficients)
cat(sprintf("Rows from cells contributing more than one: %d of %d\n",
            sum(table(target_rows$cellID)[table(target_rows$cellID) > 1]),
            nrow(target_rows)))
```
